raw.description:
ABOUT OPORTUN

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $21.3 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

WORKING AT OPORTUN

Working at Oportun means enjoying a differentiated experience of being part of a team that fosters a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where we all feel a sense of belonging and are encouraged to share our perspectives. This inclusive culture is directly connected to our organization's performance and ability to fulfill our mission of delivering affordable credit to those left out of the financial mainstream. We celebrate and nurture our inclusive culture through our employee resource groups.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are looking for a talented and creative problem solver to join Oportun as a Senior Product Manager for Lending Originations. In this role, you will lead the strategy and development of capabilities that improve the applicant experience, increase new-loan conversion, and support the financial health of Oportun’s members.

This is a senior individual contributor product role for a strategic, hands-on problem solver with a strong track record of solving complex problems and delivering meaningful customer and business outcomes. You will articulate the product strategy, establish objectives and key results, define a multi-year roadmap, and lead cross-functional teams in delivering best-in-class lending experiences.


You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Fraud, Marketing, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and other partners to identify opportunities, align priorities, and drive execution. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building simple, responsible, and accessible financial products.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Product Vision and Strategy

Own the product strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for Lending Originations journeys or capabilities, contributing to the broader multi-year Originations vision.

Establish objectives, key results, and performance metrics aligned with company priorities and member needs.

Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve application completion, approval, funding, and new-loan conversion.

Translate complex customer, business, risk, and operational needs into clear product priorities and scalable solutions.

Customer Insights and Experience

Maintain a deep understanding of applicant and member needs through user research, data analysis, surveys, experimentation, and feedback loops.

Develop frictionless lending experiences that improve applicant satisfaction while supporting responsible lending and regulatory requirements.

Identify opportunities to improve both self-service and agent-assisted originations experiences.

Product Development and Execution

Scope and lead the development of new Lending Originations products, capabilities, and features.

Lead high-performing cross-functional teams that include Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Fraud, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and Compliance.

Drive products from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, iteration, and scale.

Anticipate obstacles, manage dependencies, and help teams resolve blockers to deliver meaningful value for members and the business.

Balance near-term delivery with longer-term platform scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

Experimentation and Business Impact

Develop and execute experiments across the originations funnel to deliver measurable improvements in application completion, conversion, approval, and funding.

Define success metrics and use data to evaluate performance, identify insights, and inform product decisions.

Assess trade-offs across member experience, credit risk, fraud risk, operational efficiency, regulatory requirements, and financial performance.

Stakeholder Leadership and Communication

Build strong collaboration and alignment across a broad group of cross-functional stakeholders.

Craft a clear product narrative and communicate priorities, decisions, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to executive leadership and partner teams.

Facilitate effective decision-making in an environment with complex constraints and shifting priorities.

Influence the organization through product expertise, structured thinking, strong judgment, and clear documentation.

Risk and Regulatory Management

Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Fraud teams to ensure originations products adhere to applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry best practices.

Design solutions that balance growth and conversion objectives with responsible lending, risk management, and member protection.

Support the launch and ongoing management of products operating within complex legal and regulatory frameworks.

WHO YOU ARE / WHAT YOU BRING

Experience

7+ years of core product management experience in high-growth environments.

Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-impact product initiatives from strategy through execution and scale.

Strong track record of launching and iterating on customer-facing products that delivered measurable business and customer outcomes.

Experience in financial services, FinTech, lending, digital banking, or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred.

Customer-Centric Leadership

Passionate about improving the financial health of Oportun’s members.

Experienced in creating simple, accessible, and frictionless customer experiences.

Able to balance customer needs with business, risk, operational, and regulatory considerations.

Analytical Problem Solving

Demonstrated ability to structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems.

Strong experience using data to make decisions, define metrics, develop hypotheses, and measure results.

Experience with experimentation, funnel analysis, product analytics, and performance optimization.

Collaboration and Influence

Proven ability to build consensus and drive results across a wide range of cross-functional partners.

Comfortable influencing senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

Able to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and competing constraints.

Communication

Clear, concise, and persuasive written and verbal communicator.

Strong documentation, storytelling, and executive presentation skills.

Able to communicate complex product, technical, risk, and business concepts to different audiences.

Execution

Scrappy, solution-oriented, and accountable for outcomes.

Able to move fluidly between strategic thinking and detailed execution.

Skilled at identifying risks, managing dependencies, resolving blockers, and maintaining momentum.

Domain Knowledge

Prior experience with lending originations, credit products, underwriting, application funnels, or loan decisioning is strongly preferred.

Experience launching and managing products within complex legal and regulatory frameworks.

Familiarity with credit risk, fraud, compliance, servicing, or financial-product economics is beneficial.

About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

You will support end-to-end recruiting for A1’s product, engineering, and business roles.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep hiring moving smoothly and accurately. It’s a good fit for someone early in their career who wants to learn how high-quality technical hiring actually works in practice.

What you will be doing

  • Support the full recruitment process across roles, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer support.

  • Source candidates through a mix of channels, including LinkedIn, referrals, job boards, and proactive outreach.

  • Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate screens to assess basic role fit, motivation, and communication.

  • Coordinate interviews, scheduling, and feedback collection with candidates and hiring managers.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the ATS, ensuring data quality and process consistency.

  • Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the team scales, including candidate experience and employer branding initiatives.

  • Help keep hiring operations organised, responsive, and moving at pace.

What you will need

  • 0–2 years of experience in recruiting, HR, operations, coordination, or related roles
    (fresh graduates with a strong interest in recruiting are welcome).

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working with tools such as Google Sheets / Excel and basic ATS systems.

  • A proactive, learning-oriented mindset and openness to feedback.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through reliably.

(Prior recruiting experience is helpful but not required. Attitude, curiosity, and execution matter more.)

Why join A1

  • Learn technical recruiting from the ground up in a small, high-bar team.

  • Work closely with experienced recruiters, engineers, and hiring managers.

  • Hands-on ownership and real responsibility from day one.

  • Flat structure where initiative and execution matter more than titles.

raw.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own how the world adopts, loves, and grows with Asimov. This is a growth role at heart, sitting close to marketing and owning the customer from first touch to renewal. You will turn interest into onboarded users, users into champions, and champions into revenue across the community and partner network.

What You'll Do

  • Own a revenue target across your account base, including new business, expansion, and renewals

  • Own the customer journey end to end, from first touch and onboarding through adoption, retention, and growth

  • Turn community interest and inbound into onboarded, active, paying users

  • Build the customer stories, case studies, and references that feed the marketing engine

  • Spot expansion and upsell opportunities early and turn happy users into growing accounts

  • Run onboarding, enablement, and lifecycle programs that scale across cohorts

  • Be the voice of the customer back to marketing, product, and leadership

  • Keep a clean pulse on adoption, churn risk, and account health across the base

What We Look For

  • 3+ years in customer success, account management, or growth, with real ownership of a number

  • A track record of driving adoption, retention, and expansion in a fast-growing product

  • Strong relationship and storytelling instincts that turn users into advocates

  • Sharp communication that meets customers where they are and moves them forward

  • Bias for action in a fast-moving, ambiguous, ship-first environment

  • Genuine curiosity about robotics, open-source, and the community building on it

Nice to Have

  • Experience at an open-source, developer-facing, or hardware company

  • Background bridging customer success and marketing or growth

  • History building community, running lifecycle programs, or scaling a self-serve motion

  • Former founder, open-source contributor, or side-project builder

Why Join Menlo

You will own how a global community adopts and grows with Asimov. You will carry the number, shape the customer stories that power our brand, and see your impact in real deployments and real revenue, not slide decks. If you want to help turn open hardware into real work, come build with us.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

raw.description:
LocationOur Engineering Manager - Analytics House will be an integral part of our global R&D team.
This role is based remotely in the East Coast US, the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity
The Engineering Manager is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You are embedded with your team - daily standup, code review, architectural calls, delivery planning, and performance management - and you own both the team's output and the team's growth.
This is a genuinely technical & leadership role. You are expected to write and review code, be a credible voice in architectural decisions, and stay current in your team's stack. You lead by demonstrating you can do the work at the highest level, not by title alone.
The balance between hands-on contribution and leadership depends on the team's context, but your overarching mandate is the same: run the team, execute and deliver, and grow its impact.
Build the bench, raise the standard, and keep the operating cadence sharp as the work and the organization evolve. You work AI-augmented yourself, expect the same from your team, and push the team's craft forward with every new capability that lands.

ResponsibilitiesTeam leadership & growth

  • Leading a team of engineers, owning both its delivery and its development.
  • Lead a mindset and process of continuous improvement within the team and meaningfully impact the team’s growth and success over time. Small, compounding improvements, delivered via fast iterations, are the operating rhythm we expect, not an aspiration.
  • You are responsible for the professional well-being and career development of team members. Develop engineers through regular 1:1s, growth plans, performance reviews, and direct, candid feedback.
  • Develop the next layer of leadership - tech leads, senior engineers ready to manage, and ICs ready to step into staff roles.

Technical leadership

  • Write code and review code. Be a credible voice in technical decisions because you have hands in the work, not because of your title - you are current, not rusty.
  • Drive the team's architectural and technical design decisions in partnership with senior ICs, ensuring alignment on approach and implementation.
  • Uphold engineering standards through thorough, constructive pull-request review and a healthy release process, keeping the team's components scalable and in a healthy state.
  • Work AI-augmented and lead an AI-augmented team, applying sharp judgment about where AI helps and holding the same quality bar for what ships.

Roadmap & delivery

  • Own the team's commitments - what was promised, when it was promised, and the quality bar that was held.
  • Run a disciplined cadence of planning, prioritization, and delivery without becoming a process bureaucrat.
  • Partner closely with the Technical Product Owner and Product team on scope, sequencing, and tradeoffs, maintaining a roadmap that reflects both near-term priorities and longer-term direction.
  • Understand the broader business objectives behind the work, translate that context for the team, and ensure engineering effort clearly aligns with those objectives.
  • React decisively to change - re-planning, re-prioritizing, and re-staffing as the business moves - while keeping the team engaged and steady through the shift.

Hiring

  • Own hiring for your team. Interview thoughtfully, decide quickly, and refuse to lower the bar to fill seats.
  • Recruit, coach, and - when needed - make hard calls toward the standard the team is held to.
  • Operate as a role model for other engineering managers across the organization: share your operating model, mentor peers, and raise the management bench.

Day-to-day communication & collaboration

  • Upwards: Communicate clearly and succinctly, giving leadership the right level of context and prioritizing escalations based on relevant, well-gathered information.
  • Downwards: Empower senior engineers to own key areas of the product, and coach team members to stay focused, intentional, and aware of their impact.
  • Sideways: Partner effectively with Product, Design, GTM, Customer Success, and other teams - raising challenges and opportunities constructively to support cross-team alignment.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering management roles where you actively coded as part of your responsibilities.
  • Hands-on, real-life experience building cloud-based SaaS products - running services in production on AWS, GCP, or Azure, and owning availability, cost, and the customer-facing surface.
  • API first mindset, products are built not just for end user experience through UI, they are fully functional and available through APIs, so both humans and agents can interact with the platform
  • Strong background in databases, SQL, query optimization, and BigQuery.
  • A track record of taking an engineering team and visibly transforming it - measurable improvements in delivery velocity, technical quality, or team caliber.
  • Deep technical fluency in your team's primary stack. You can read, write, and review code at a senior level, and you are current - not rusty.
  • Strong opinions on how high-performing engineering teams operate, and a clear philosophy on hiring, coaching, performance management, and technical decision-making.
  • Excellent judgment under pressure. You make calls quickly with imperfect information, communicate them clearly, and take responsibility for the outcomes.
  • Direct, candid communication. You give hard feedback well, and you hear it well.

Bonus Points

  • A strong, already-established AI-augmented workflow, with opinions on how to apply AI tools and agentic workflows to raise both velocity and quality.
  • Hands-on experience with more than a single cloud provider.
  • Background in scaling teams, processes, or technical systems as the organization grows.

    Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
    We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

    What does being a Do’er mean? We’re all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
    Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
    We thought so too, but we’re here and happy we hit that ‘apply’ button.

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

raw.description:
About the Role

The Partner Marketing Manager will help scale our global partnership program. This is a relationship-driven, execution-focused role for a marketer who excels at building joint go-to-market momentum and translating strategy into high-quality execution. You will partner closely with partner marketing counterparts and Channel Account Managers (CAMs) to plan and deliver integrated programs across digital marketing, events, thought leadership, and partner enablement. You will support partners across North America and EMEA and require strong organizational discipline, collaboration, and a passion for delivering polished, impactful programs.

Reports to

Director of Field Marketing

Pay Classification

Full-Time, Exempt

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with partner marketing counterparts at A-LIGN’s key partners to build quarterly joint go-to-market plans, including co-owned digital programs (webinars, whitepapers, content series, and email campaigns) and in-person activations
  • Develop and manage a co-marketing activity calendar aligned to sales strategy and partner pipeline goals, ensuring each program has clear objectives, defined ownership, and measurable outcomes
  • Create and manage the assets required to bring joint programs to life — including co-branded content, campaign briefs, enablement materials, and post-event reporting
  • Track and report on program performance, translating results into insights that inform future planning cycles with each partner
  • Partner closely with Channel Account Managers (CAMs) to plan and execute a broad portfolio of partner-facing events, including thought leadership programs, educational workshops, and curated entertainment and networking experiences that deepen the A-LIGN–partner relationship
  • Identify and develop new event formats and activations that create memorable moments and drive stronger partner engagement over time
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders across the partner ecosystem, including partner contacts, CAMs, sales leadership, and joint clients
  • Contribute to the overall partner marketing strategy, bringing a point of view on what programs, formats, and investments will have the greatest impact on partnership growth
  • Continuously optimize program effectiveness measuring what works, optimizing what doesn’t, and raising the bar on partner experience and execution quality over time

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or other relevant field 

EXPERIENCE

  • 3+ years in partner marketing, channel marketing, or alliance marketing, with direct experience building joint go-to-market programs
  • 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally with exposure to demand generation, campaigns, or field marketing
  • Demonstrated experience planning and executing co-marketing programs across both digital (webinars, content, email) and in-person formats
  • Experience collaborating directly with sales or channel teams (e.g., CAMs, partner sales) to align marketing programs to revenue goals
  • Proficiency in Salesforce; familiarity with marketing automation tools (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo) preferred

SKILLS

  • Strong relationship builder who earns trust quickly with partner contacts and internal stakeholders alike
  • Execution-oriented: you bring structure and follow-through to every program and hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not just activities
  • Excellent project and program management skills; you comfortably manage multiple partners and workstreams simultaneously without dropping the ball
  • Strong written and verbal communicator with the ability to create compelling content and present confidently to partner audiences
  • High attention to detail and a drive to continuously improve the quality and effectiveness of everything you own
  • Self-motivated and collaborative; equally comfortable driving a program independently or co-creating it with partners and cross-functional teammates
  • Comfortable working across time zones and regions in a fast-paced, global environment

Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance and Disability Insurance
  • EAP - Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) Plan with Employer Matching
  • Competitive Bonus Structure
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Personalized Career Coaching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1
  • Vacation Bonus
  • Summer Hours

About A-LIGN

A-LIGN is the leading provider of high-quality, efficient cybersecurity compliance programs. Combining experienced auditors and audit management technology, A-LIGN provides the widest breadth and depth of services including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, FedRAMP, and PCI. A-LIGN is the number one issuer of SOC 2 and HITRUST and a top three FedRAMP assessor. To learn more, visit a-lign.com.

Come Work for A-LIGN!

Apply online today at A-LIGN.com and learn about life at A-LIGN by following us onLinkedIn.

A-LIGN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Minorities, women, disabled, and veterans encouraged to apply!

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Are you passionate about technology and ready to dive into the world of Site Reliability Engineering? We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Site Reliability Engineer II, where you'll play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and performance of our platform. This is a top-notch opportunity to learn from skilled engineers and contribute to solving complex technical challenges. You will be involved in monitoring systems, responding to incidents, and developing automation to streamline operations. We are looking for someone eager to grow their skills, learn new technologies, and contribute to a culture of reliability.

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team integrates software and systems engineering to design and manage large-scale, distributed, and fault-tolerant systems. The team is responsible for ensuring high reliability, optimal system performance, and continuous improvement for both Instacart’s critical internal services and externally visible systems.

SRE’s work emphasizes optimizing existing systems, developing robust infrastructure, and automating processes to reduce manual tasks. Joining the SRE team means tackling unique scaling challenges while applying expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis, and large-scale system design.

The team thrives on a culture of intellectual curiosity, problem-solving, and collaboration. With members from diverse backgrounds and experiences, SRE fosters a supportive and risk-tolerant environment where individuals can think big, take on meaningful projects, and grow with guidance and mentorship.

About the Job

  • Participate in monitoring systems and responding to alerts, escalating issues as needed.
  • Assist in incident management, following established protocols and documenting steps.
  • Help maintain and improve documentation for processes and procedures.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools.
  • Learn and apply best practices in site reliability engineering.
  • Support the deployment of applications and services, ensuring smooth and reliable releases.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to troubleshoot and tackle technical issues.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of Software engineering experience.
  • Understanding of programming concepts and scripting languages.
  • Strong interest in system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong sense of ownership on incident handling.
  • Ability to work well in a team environment and communicate effectively.
  • Eagerness to learn and grow in the field of Site Reliability Engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Ruby or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.
  • Previous SRE experience a plus

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

Summary

We are seeking a skilled RV Technician to diagnose, repair, and maintain recreational vehicles (RVs). This role involves working on mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical systems to ensure RVs operate safely and efficiently. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in RV maintenance, towing experience, and excellent customer service skills. Additionally, the technician will provide support to customers both in person and through remote or virtual consultations, advising on necessary repairs or maintenance, ensuring RVs operate according to manufacturer specifications, and maintaining detailed service documentation to support both in-shop and virtual interactions. Candidates must have a modern smartphone with an active internet connection to efficiently manage orders and assignments through the company app. Proficiency in navigating mobile applications, digital platforms, and app-based workflows is essential for seamless task execution and communication.


Compensation ranges from $45,760 to $79,040 per year, based on experience and availability.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnose and repair issues in RV systems, including mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical.
  • Inspect RVs to identify potential problems or needed maintenance.
  • Perform general and preventative maintenance to ensure safe and efficient operation.
  • Troubleshoot and repair issues related to engines, brakes, axles, and other RV components.
  • Handle towing tasks, ensuring safe and secure transport of RVs.
  • Communicate repair needs and recommendations to clients clearly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, and services performed.
  • Ensure all tools, equipment, and workspace comply with safety standards.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

High school diploma or GED equivalent.

Experience

  • Minimum of 2+ years of experience in RV maintenance and repair.
  • Basic knowledge of RV systems, including plumbing, HVAC, and electrical.
  • 2+ years of towing experience, with a strong understanding of secure towing protocols.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with local roads and geography is a plus.

Why Join Us?

Our innovative approach to remote mechanic jobs is reshaping the industry, offering unparalleled opportunities for skilled professionals like you. By joining our team, you'll be at the forefront of this revolution, leveraging cutting-edge technology to provide expert services from anywhere. With flexible schedules and the ability to work remotely, you'll enjoy greater freedom and autonomy in your career. Plus, our commitment to inclusivity ensures that every team member is valued and supported. If you're ready to be part of a forward-thinking organization that's changing the game for mechanics, apply now and embark on a rewarding journey with us.

About Company

At our organization, we're on a mission to revolutionize the opportunities available in the mechanic industry by pioneering remote mechanic jobs. We believe that skilled mechanics shouldn't be limited by traditional brick-and-mortar settings but should have the flexibility to work remotely, leveraging technology to provide expert services wherever they're needed. By embracing remote work, we're empowering mechanics to optimize their schedules, reduce commuting time, and expand their reach to serve clients beyond geographical boundaries. Through innovative platforms and robust support systems, we're creating a new paradigm in the mechanic industry, one that prioritizes efficiency, accessibility, and inclusivity. Join us in shaping the future of remote mechanics and unlocking endless possibilities for professionals in the field.

Are you an experienced Mandarin Chinese voice actor eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models and speech technologies are evolving rapidly, moving beyond simple interactions into expressive, human-like communication. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more natural, accurate, and engaging voice experiences across education, entertainment, accessibility, and beyond. That training data begins with you—your voice expertise will help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for a highly skilled Mandarin Chinese voice acting professional who can bring nuance, clarity, and authenticity to training data. You’ll work with cutting-edge AI tools, record and evaluate Mandarin Chinese speech samples, and provide expert feedback on pronunciation, tone, pacing, and emotional expression to strengthen voice models.

On a typical day, you will record scripted material, assess AI-generated outputs for linguistic accuracy and naturalness, annotate errors, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation methods, and voice design guidelines.

Fluency in Mandarin Chinese is required, along with demonstrated experience in professional voice acting, dubbing, narration, or related performance work. Experience in training, coaching, or linguistic annotation is a plus. Clear communication skills and attention to detail are essential. A high-quality recording setup—including a reliable microphone and a quiet environment—is required.

Ready to channel your Mandarin Chinese voice expertise into building the AI voices of tomorrow? Apply today and help shape the model that will speak to millions around the world.

We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer, high-quality microphone and recording setup, and stable internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

ACCOUNT MANAGER

This posting is for an existing vacancy. While applications are being accepted from candidates across multiple geographic regions across Canada, there is currently one (1) position available.

SUMMARY

Netagen is seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Account Manager to join our team. At Netagen, Account Managers play a visible role in helping clients get lasting value from technology and telecommunications solutions. This position is ideal for a relationship-driven sales professional who wants to own a portfolio, grow trusted client partnerships, and contribute directly to retention, expansion, and long-term customer success.

The Account Manager owns, nurtures, and expands relationships within an assigned portfolio of existing clients. This role focuses on understanding each client’s business priorities, building trusted partnerships, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring clients receive responsive, reliable service. This role also includes a targeted new-customer development component, requiring the Account Manager to build relationships with prospective clients, uncover business needs, and introduce Netagen solutions that create long-term value. Working closely with internal teams, the Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for client inquiries and helps strengthen Netagen’s reputation for long-term partnership, customer satisfaction, and growth.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with assigned clients by understanding their business objectives, operational priorities, and evolving needs.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and client touchpoints to assess satisfaction, strengthen relationships, identify risks, and uncover renewal, retention, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Grow account revenue by identifying and pursuing opportunities that align clients’ needs with Netagen's products and services.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, proactively addressing concerns, resolving issues, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Partner with internal teams, including Operations, Shared Organizational Services, Sales Design, and Sales Support, to coordinate service delivery and develop solutions that meet client requirements.
  • Manage account renewals, contract amendments, and service changes while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and maintaining accurate account documentation.
  • Maintain current and accurate client, opportunity, pipeline, and activity records within CRM systems; prepare reports and forecasts as required.
  • Monitor client account health, identify potential risks to retention, and implement strategies to strengthen engagement and minimize churn.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, market conditions, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to provide relevant recommendations and insights to clients.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development, training, and industry events to maintain product knowledge and strengthen consultative selling capabilities.
  • Contribute to sales forecasting and business planning activities by maintaining accurate pipeline and account information
  • Achieve or exceed assigned revenue, renewal, and account growth objectives
  • Develop and execute account plans for key clients to support long-term growth, retention, and client success.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • University or College degree in business, marketing, sales or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 3+ years experience in account management, customer success, or inside sales, ideally within the technology or telecommunications industry
  • Bilingualism (English and French) considered an asset
  • Proven track record of maintaining client relationships and achieving sales or retention targets
  • Strong consultative and value-based selling capability, with experience uncovering business challenges, quantifying client impact, and positioning solutions around measurable outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, SPIN Selling, Sandler, or similar qualification and opportunity-management frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new customer opportunities while also expanding existing accounts through renewal, upsell, and cross-sell strategies.
  • Ability to build account plans, map stakeholders and decision processes, identify economic buyers, manage compelling events, and advance opportunities through a disciplined sales cycle.
  • Experience building and managing a qualified pipeline, maintaining accurate CRM data, tracking opportunity stages, and applying consistent next-step discipline.
  • Ability to forecast account growth, renewal risk, and new business opportunities using customer insights, activity metrics, and opportunity qualification criteria.
  • Confident communicator able to engage stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical contacts, business leaders, procurement teams, and executive decision-makers.
  • Skilled at discovery, active listening, objection handling, commercial negotiation, and presenting business cases that connect client needs to clear solution value.
  • Comfortable learning and selling technology, telecommunications, managed services, connectivity, collaboration, or related business solutions to commercial clients.
  • Ability to translate product, service, and market knowledge into client-specific recommendations that support retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.
  • Customer-focused, resilient, and commercially curious, with a proactive approach to solving problems, creating trust, and identifying new ways to help clients succeed.

We are looking for candidates that are serious about their careers and hold a high level of enthusiasm for building a strong successful company, as we do.

ABOUT NETAGEN

Since 2001, evolving from Combat Networks, Netagen has been leading the industry with a unique personalized approach to communication solutions, empowering Businesses and Governments to meet their goals and stay connected to things that matter the most.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base Salary Range: $70,000 - $100,000 annually

The final offer will be based on factors including experience, skills, knowledge, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a performance-based incentive plan.

Netagen also offers:

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance.
  • Long-term disability (LTD) insurance.
  • Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance.
  • Paid vacation and personal time

WHY JOIN NETAGEN?

At Netagen, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, client-focused environment where employees are empowered to make an impact, build meaningful relationships, and grow their careers.

As an Account Manager, you will have the opportunity to develop trusted client partnerships, contribute directly to business growth and work alongside experienced technology and telecommunications professionals. You’ll be supported with ongoing learning opportunities, flexible work arrangements, and a performance-driven compensation program that recognizes results.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your sales expertise, expand your industry knowledge, or take the next step in your career, Netagen offers a dynamic and supportive environment where your contributions are valued and your success is recognized.

DIVERSITY EQUITY & INCLUSION

Netagen is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and lived experiences.

Accommodation is available upon request throughout the recruitment, selection, and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Role: The Mortgage Loan Boarding Specialist supports the 7 Servicing mission by ensuring newly originated and transferred mortgage loans are accurately set up in the servicing system. This role plays a critical part in providing a smooth experience for our members by making sure loan information is complete, accurate, and ready for ongoing servicing.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Reviews mortgage loan documents and data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency prior to boarding.
  • Sets up newly originated and transferred mortgage loans on the servicing platform in accordance with credit union policies and investor requirements.
  • Verifies key loan details including: loan terms, interest rate, and payment information, member/borrower information, escrow setup for taxes and insurance, and investor and product type.

raw.description:
Highlights:

Location: Cyprus, remote

Engagement type: Part-time, 10–20 hrs/week — flexible schedule, but high responsiveness required 12:00–18:00 CET

Language: Russian-speaking team

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

The best internal tools disappear — they just make everyone else faster. As our Tools Engineer, you'll build and maintain the automations, bots, and AI assistants that quietly remove routine work across the company. This is a generalist, fullstack-with-backend-bias role: you'll touch our project-management system, Slack and Telegram, and a growing set of AI-powered assistants, and you'll be trusted to decide how each problem should be solved. It's distinct from QA automation — your mandate is internal productivity, not test infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own internal automation for our project-management system (TargetProcess) — building custom rules, workflow logic, and integrations with other internal systems.
  • Design and ship bots for Slack and Telegram that carry out real work — creating tasks, delivering notifications, and answering routine requests.
  • Automate recurring operational processes — on-call/duty announcements, absence notices, reminders, and similar workflows that would otherwise need manual attention.
  • Build AI-powered assistants and agents that help employees get fast, accurate answers and complete routine tasks.
  • Build lightweight internal mini-projects that support company events and culture (for example, a prediction/betting site for New Year).
  • Document every solution you ship — what it does, how it works, and how to operate or extend it — so tools stay maintainable and don't depend on any one person.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including automation, bot development, and process automation
  • Fullstack capability with a clear backend bias
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js
  • Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, or similar)
  • Experience with serverless platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, or equivalent)
  • Experience with MongoDB, ClickHouse, and/or PostgreSQL — comfortable working across both relational and non-relational databases
  • Practical experience building bots for Slack and/or Telegram
  • Hands-on experience automating processes and integrating third-party APIs
  • Working knowledge of OpenAI/LLM APIs
  • Able to work autonomously, make decisions, and own outcomes without close supervision
  • Reliable in honouring commitments and agreements
  • English proficiency sufficient for daily written and verbal communication
  • Able to maintain strong availability/responsiveness during 12:00–18:00 CET, even on a flexible part-time schedule

Nice to Have

  • Experience building RAG pipelines or agent-based systems

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • You'd rather build the tool that removes the work than do the work by hand
  • You're comfortable owning a wide, shifting surface of systems with no single "home stack"
  • You take documentation seriously — you write it so someone else could pick up your work tomorrow
  • You can be handed an ambiguous "this is annoying, fix it" problem and turn it into a shipped automation
  • You're reliable by default — if you commit to something, it happens
  • You like the flexibility of part-time contract work but don't use it as an excuse to be hard to reach
  • You're curious about AI tooling and treat it as a working part of your toolkit, not a side experiment

Compensation

  • €35 – €37,50 per hour, based on 10–20 hrs/week.

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team:

As a fundamental pillar of the platform, Horizon enables different business models within CookUnity, ensuring that users can seamlessly subscribe to plans, manage their preferences, and successfully place their orders.

The team is responsible for two key areas:

  1. Enabling Business Models and Subscriptions: Horizon ensures that diverse user segments have access to tailored plans and subscription models, optimizing their experience within the platform. This involves continuous iteration and experimentation to provide the best possible journey for each type of user.
  2. Order Management and Integrity: Horizon acts as the source of truth for user orders, ensuring their accuracy and reliability. The team handles critical processes such as order creation, autopilot selection, and delivery eligibility based on user addresses, guaranteeing a seamless experience from selection to fulfillment.

By combining a strong user experience focus with backend robustness, Horizon plays a vital role in shaping the way users interact with CookUnity and ensuring operational stability across the platform.

The Role:

As a Staff Full Stack Engineer on the Horizons Squad, you will play a crucial role in leading technical initiatives, driving architectural decisions, and mentoring engineers as we scale our user experiences. You’ll work on building and optimizing backend services and APIs that power CookUnity’s experience. This role involves working on the Server-Driven UI (SDUI) service within our Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architecture, as well as developing and maintaining backend services and databases.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer who thrives on complexity and enjoys designing scalable, resilient, and high-performing backend systems. You will collaborate closely with engineering leadership, product managers, and cross-functional teams—including Data teams—to build and improve mission-critical infrastructure that enables personalized user experiences across our platform.

We’re looking for someone who can bring strong system design expertise, lead projects from concept to deployment, and set a high technical bar for the team while driving forward best practices in software engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable backend services that power CookUnity’s personalization systems
  • Define and drive architectural improvements that enhance system reliability, scalability, and maintainability
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Data teams to provide our users tailor-made content that adjust to their needs
  • Mentor and guide other engineers, setting a high standard for technical excellence and a culture of proactive ownership
  • Evaluate and introduce new technologies, frameworks, AI adoptions that improve our backend stack and development velocity
  • Improve system observability, performance, and resilience, ensuring uptime and smooth operation of revenue-critical systems
  • Contribute as a hands-on engineer, writing clean, well-tested, and efficient code, leading by example
  • Lead technical planning and project execution, breaking down complex problems into manageable solutions and driving initiatives to on-time completion
  • Support the on-call rotation to help the business run 24/7

Minimum Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in full stack/backend software development, with expertise in React, Kotlin, TypeScript, and SQL databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL)
  • Proven experience in architecting and scaling complex backend systems in a high-growth, fast-paced environment
  • Strong knowledge of distributed systems, service-oriented architecture, and event-driven architecture
  • Deep understanding of system performance and scalability best practices
  • Proven ability to translate complex, ambiguous requirements into clear, actionable plans that drive alignment and timely delivery
  • Advanced English communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated experience in mentoring and guiding engineers
  • Fluency with AI engineering tools.

Ideal Requirements:

  • Experience with DevOps tools and cloud platforms, including Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS
  • Experience with React Native.

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want

⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date

🎄 16 fully paid Argentinean holidays

🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider

🧘🏽‍♀️ Flexible benefits, your way: a prepaid card you can use on wellness, learning, food, and more.

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

  • 7+ years of relevant experience

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Remote position
  • Travel up to 25%, if applicable

Why Join Velotic

Velotic is uniquely positioned at the intersection of industrial operations, advanced connectivity, and AI. Joining now means you can help shape:

Culture & Growth

  • Build foundational People Ops systems, processes, and culture from day one.
  • Work within a team defined by ambition, collaboration, authenticity, and speed.

Work-Life Balance

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)
  • Global paid parental leave

Join Us

Learn more at:

WHO WE ARE

We unite two category-defining portfolios -- ThingWorx and Kepware (formerly part of PTC) and Proficy (formerly part of GE Vernova) -- to transform industrial manufacturing, at scale. With $350M in annual revenue, a global footprint across a range of industries, a legacy customer base, and our intelligent data connectivity systems and AI solutions, we are one of the world's largest independent software companies focused on industrial operations -- here to power the future of manufacturing.

Enabling the world's industrial producers to do the right things right—across every shift, every plant, every day. WHY THIS IS A ONCE-IN-A-CAREER OPPORTUNITY

raw.description:
About Starbridge

We're building the front door for how businesses partner with government in America.

Public agencies spend roughly a trillion dollars a year with private companies, and nearly all of it still moves through infrastructure that hasn't changed in decades. Starbridge is building the full operating system for that relationship: the data, the signals, the workflows, and the rails that let a company find a public buyer, win the work, and get paid.

We monitor 320,000+ public sector entities around the clock. 500+ customers have joined us since our launch in March. We've raised $50M from Craft and top investors including Michael Seibel of Y Combinator.

About the role

We’re hiring a GTM Engineer to own our scaled outbound motion. You’ll work closely with the Chief Growth Officer to build and optimize workflows that drive personalized, high‑volume outreach using modern GTM tools. This role blends technical implementation with creative problem‑solving to generate pipeline in a large, underpenetrated market.

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Large TAM: Work in a $1.5T market with huge growth potential

  • Rich Intent Data: Leverage evergreen buying signals for high‑value outreach

  • Impact: Own a critical growth lever at a scaling B2B SaaS company

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years managing GTM workflows at a B2B SaaS company

  • Experience with tools like Clay, Claude Code, , Smartlead, HeyReach, n8n, etc.

  • Ability to integrate systems and create no‑code/low‑code automations

  • Familiarity with scaled outbound strategies and deliverability best practices

Interview Process

We move fast — really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed. All interviews are conducted via Google Meet.

How We Work

  • Build Bridges to Help Customers Win - We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.

  • Shooting Star Speed - We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.

  • Fun Is a Feature - Fun is a Feature means we intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.

  • In the Arena - We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

Benefits include:

  • Competitive salary + early-stage equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Regular offsites (NYC + global locations)

Compensation Range: $120K - $160K

raw.description:
Description

﻿You’re already in the Identity Security space or an adjacent space in product marketing. You’re used to (and addicted to) the intensity and space of startup life. You can go deep on the product and put yourself in the customer’s shoes. You go toe-to-toe with Sales Engineers when it comes to demos. You’re well-versed in using AI tooling but not overly reliant on it (meaning not everything you write feels like ChatGPT). You’re resilient and good at prioritizing.

What You’ll Do:

As a Director, Product Marketing at Linx, you’ll bridge the needs of security, IT, and compliance teams with our product, helping them master Identity Security and love using Linx. You’ll partner with product, sales, customer success and demand generation to launch new products and features and position Linx as the leader in Identity space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer by understanding their needs and challenges through interviews, market research, competitive analysis, and engagement with sales teams.
  • Strategic Messaging: Develop compelling positioning and messaging frameworks for products, personas, and features, collaborating closely with product and sales to address specific needs. Craft tailored messaging for demand generation, SDR, sales, and channel partners.
  • Sales Enablement: Empower the entire organization with relevant product and customer knowledge. Create essential sales collateral, including playbooks, sales plays, and pitch decks.
  • Product Launch Management: Lead and execute product launch strategies, partnering with product management, demand generation, sales, and customer success teams.
  • Market Education: Collaborate with demand generation on content strategies to achieve product goals, producing collateral such as blogs, whitepapers, webpages, demos, and videos.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring:

  • 4+ years experience in cybersecurity product marketing, ideally in Identity (IGA, PAM, IAM) or an adjacent space like SaaS Security or asset management.
  • Strong writer and public speaker who is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to create stand-out marketing content and sales enablement.
  • Skilled project manager who can keep stakeholders informed and projects on track.
  • Technical curiosity and an aptitude for learning. You understand the identity ecosystem and practices.
  • You represent the voice-of-the-customer and can distill actionable product roadmap recommendations from customer feedback, market research, and competitive analysis.

raw.description:
📌 Contexte du poste

Vous interviendrez au sein d’un périmètre composé de deux systèmes d'information :

  • un premier hébergé dans Azure, fortement orienté événements
  • un second opéré sur une plateforme interne.

L’équipe reçoit et traite des fichiers déclenchant une chaîne d’événements permettant de gérer un référentiel de données.
Les données issues de ce référentiel sont ensuite diffusées par des API vers un portail web utilisé par un acteur externe majeur.

La partie Azure repose sur des services événementiels et des micro-services.
La partie interne est principalement développée en Java / Spring Boot.

🎯 Rôle du Tech Lead

Votre rôle sera majoritairement orienté pilotage, conception, architecture et coordination.
Même si le volume de développement reste limité, vous devrez être parfaitement en mesure de débuguer, analyser et accompagner techniquement l’équipe.

Vous serez également en lien régulier avec le Product Owner du client final pour challenger les besoins et valider la faisabilité technique.

📌 Vos missions

Pilotage & Architecture

  • Piloter les activités techniques de l’équipe de développement.
  • Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture applicative.
  • Analyser l’obsolescence technique et proposer des améliorations.
  • Encadrer la réalisation de POC et orienter les choix techno.
  • Garantir la cohérence technique globale des solutions.

Qualité & Gouvernance

  • Réaliser des revues de code et veiller aux bonnes pratiques.
  • Assurer la qualité, la performance et la sécurité des développements.
  • Contribuer aux standards techniques et à la gouvernance.

  • Défendre vos choix techniques auprès des équipes internes et partenaires.
  • Participer aux cérémonies et processus d’un cadre SAFe.

Technique & Build

  • Investiguer et résoudre les problématiques techniques complexes.
  • Maîtriser et comprendre le fonctionnement événementiel Azure.

📌 Stack technique

Technologies principales

  • Java 8, 17, 21
  • Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Batch
  • Micro-services
  • Azure (pas d’AWS)
  • JEE – EJB3, Struts

🎯 Profil recherché

Expérience

  • 7 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement Java.
  • Au moins 1 à 2 ans d’expérience en tant que Tech Lead.
  • Expérience en environnements micro-services ou orientés événements appréciée.

Compétences techniques

Indispensables

  • Excellente maîtrise de Java & Spring Boot.
  • Très bonne compréhension des architectures micro-services.
  • Connaissance ou expérience des services Azure.
  • Capacité à débuguer et analyser des chaînes de traitement complexes.
  • Capacité à arbitrer et à prendre des décisions techniques.

Optionnelles

  • Connaissance de Struts, EJB3.
  • Expérience dans un cadre méthodologique SAFe.
  • Expérience sur un référentiel de données.

🎯 Qualités humaines

  • Leadership naturel et sens de la pédagogie.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication.
  • Capacité à convaincre et à fédérer.
  • Esprit analytique et vision long terme.
  • Autonomie, rigueur et sens du résultat.

💥 Avantages :

Pour mieux se connaître, voici nos étapes de recrutement (réponse garantie) :

📞 Entretien téléphonique (15 min)

👥 Entretien RH (1 h) + débrief des 2 exercices en ligne (non éliminatoires)

Chez nous : mutuelle & transport à 50%, tickets resto (9,5€ à 60%), primes cooptation 1000€, CSE, intégration 2 semaines, formation, mobilité, équipe soudée, stabilité et croissance.

HELPLINE est spécialisée dans l’infogérance du support utilisateur et la mise en œuvre d’une expérience collaborateur augmentée par l’IA, où l’expertise humaine et la technologie s’enrichissent mutuellement. raw.title: Quantum Computing Experts: Technical Audit of a Beginner Exam
raw.excerpt: What We're ResearchingWe're running a paid study on educational assessment in the quantum computing space.
raw.description:
What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on educational assessment in the quantum computing space. We are hiring domain experts to evaluate a structured exam paper designed for beginners. The goal is to ensure all technical questions, code prompts, and rubrics are scientifically sound and free of ambiguity.

How It Works

During this remote task, you will review a JSON file containing multiple-choice and short-answer questions covering fundamental quantum concepts like qubits, superposition, and entanglement. You will audit the provided answers for technical correctness and ensure distractor options are logically distinct. Additionally, you will verify Qiskit code questions, evaluate the grading rubrics, and propose edge test cases for the code evaluations. Finally, you will return an approved or corrected version of the exam dataset.

Who This Is For

We welcome quantum software engineers, quantum physicists, and computer scientists specializing in quantum information. You should have strong practical experience with quantum circuits, quantum gates, and the Qiskit framework. We also welcome academic instructors or teaching assistants who have previously designed coursework in quantum mechanics or applied quantum computing.

What You'll Do

  • Audit multiple-choice options and correct answers for technical accuracy and clarity

  • Verify the accuracy of Qiskit code snippets used to generate quantum states

  • Review and refine grading rubrics for short-answer and coding questions

  • Propose and document edge test cases to ensure robust automated grading

  • Submit a corrected JSON file containing the finalized exam questions and answers

Who Should Apply

  • Professional or academic background in quantum computing or quantum physics

  • Hands-on experience writing and evaluating quantum circuits using Qiskit

  • Strong understanding of core quantum concepts like superposition and entanglement

  • Comfortable reading and editing structured JSON data

Compensation

$11 one-time

Ready to participate?

Start your paid interview now

About Terac

Terac is building the world's largest pool of vetted human experts for AI. Researchers, AI labs, and product teams use Terac to recruit, screen, and pay study participants across industries, languages, and skill sets.

Learn more at or on YouTube at @jointerac.

raw.title: Senior Regional Sales Manager
raw.excerpt: Company OverviewRecognized as a Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Top Workplace for 14 consecutive years, including three years of being honored as number one!
raw.description:
Company Overview

Recognized as a Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Top Workplace for 14 consecutive years, including three years of being honored as number one! Join us at West Bend, where we believe that our associates are our greatest asset. We hire talented individuals who are conscientious, dedicated, customer focused, and able to build lasting relationships. We create and maintain an environment where you feel a sense of belonging and appreciation. Your diversity of thought, experience, and knowledge are valued. We’re committed to fostering a welcoming culture, offering you opportunities for meaningful work and professional growth. More than a workplace, we celebrate our successes and take pride in serving our communities.

Job Summary

Develop and execute strategic plans to maximize business opportunities through independent insurance agencies within the assigned territory. Support, measure, and monitor internal and external sales efforts including short-term promotions, social media opportunities, rollovers, co-op, etc. Create specific goals for each agency that support and stimulate corporate profit and growth objectives.

Work Location

This is a fully remote/work from home role where you will spend 50% of your time in the field, servicing the Detroit/Eastern MI territory. On occasion you may be asked to travel to an office location for in-person engagement activities such as team meetings, training and corporate events.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

While this role is fully remote, the nature of the position requires the associate to live within the assigned territory. Applicants residing outside of the territory are encouraged to apply only if they intend to relocate at their own expense.

Summary of Responsibilities

Join our team as a key driver of growth and agency success within your assigned territory. In this impactful role, you’ll develop and execute strategic plans that expand business opportunities through strong, productive partnerships with independent insurance agencies. You’ll guide and support agency initiatives—including promotions, social media campaigns, rollovers, co-op efforts, and more—to achieve meaningful results tied to our corporate profit and growth goals.

You’ll stay ahead of the industry by monitoring market trends, competitive activity, policy shifts, and regulatory changes, ensuring we’re positioned for long-term success. You will also conduct agency performance evaluations and oversee participation in our Partners in Excellence program to promote continuous improvement.

Business Development & Agency Growth

  • Drive new business opportunities by identifying, prospecting, and appointing high-potential agencies.

  • Build and nurture strong agency relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact.

  • Partner closely with the sales team to meet or exceed territory sales objectives.

  • Deliver clear, confident product and service insights while addressing agency inquiries and needs.

Relationship Management & Collaboration

  • Cultivate strong connections with agents, underwriters, and internal stakeholders to ensure exceptional service and alignment.

  • Collaborate with underwriting teams by providing territory insights, feedback, and recommendations.

  • Track issues and trends to identify training opportunities or service gaps.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Analyze territory performance and key metrics to identify opportunities and areas of success.

  • Prepare regular performance reports and present actionable insights to Sales and Underwriting leadership teams.

Training, Promotion & Engagement

  • Lead agency training sessions focused on new products, services, and industry updates.

  • Develop and deliver creative training and sales programs through teleconferences, webinars, social media, and other tools to support agency growth and profitability.

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional experience in the property/casualty insurance industry

  • Strong understanding of insurance products, underwriting processes, and regulatory requirements

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Dynamics, SharePoint, and Power BI

  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, and communication skills

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams

  • Proven track record of achieving or surpassing sales goals

Preferred Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Insurance, or a related field

  • CIC or CPCU designation required

  • Valid insurance agent’s license

  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record

(Title and level for this role may be adjusted commensurate with the experience, skills, and expertise of the successful candidate.)

Salary Statement

The salary range for this position is $100,000-$125,000.  

 

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.  Compensation decisions are made by West Bend and are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. 

Benefits

West Bend offers a comprehensive benefit plan including but not limited to:  

  • Medical & Prescription Insurance 
  • Health Savings Account 
  • Dental Insurance 
  • Vision Insurance 
  • Short and Long Term Disability 
  • Flexible Spending Accounts 
  • Life and Accidental Death & Disability  
  • Accident and Critical Illness Insurance 
  • Employee Assistance Program 
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match 
  • Pet Insurance 
  • Paid Time Off. Standard first year PTO is 17 days, pro-rated based on month of hire. Enhanced PTO may be available for experienced candidates
  • Bonus eligible based on performance 
  • West Bend will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for Colorado employees, in accordance with its plans and policies.

EEO

West Bend provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, and promotion.

  • Responsible for maintaining, updating, and understanding all client to company interactions.

  • Monitor performance of all assigned accounts and facilitate timely intervention when appropriate.
