raw.excerpt: About iCOUNTERiCOUNTER is building the future of cybersecurity.
raw.description:
About iCOUNTER

iCOUNTER is building the future of cybersecurity.

Modern enterprises rely on thousands of third parties, suppliers, SaaS providers, contractors, and digital partners. At the same time, attackers have shifted their focus to these trusted relationships. Today, nearly half of reported breaches involve a third party, making the extended enterprise one of the largest attack surfaces in cybersecurity.

iCOUNTER is the first Risk Intelligence company built to help organizations identify, determine, and counter threats across their ecosystem. Our AI-native platform makes a Risk Determination at the point of intelligence collection, helping organizations understand what is real, what is relevant, and what requires action.

At the center of our platform is CTOS™, the Counter Threat Operating System. CTOS continuously monitors adversary activity, credential exposure, targeting behavior, and ecosystem risk across third and fourth parties. It then routes intelligence into action through automated workflows and managed operations.

If you want to help define the next era of cybersecurity and build technology that helps organizations stop monitoring threats and start countering them, we'd love to meet you.

Job Overview

We are looking for a driven and experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business and expanding relationships within enterprise and commercial accounts, with a focus on cybersecurity and threat intelligence solutions.

This is a full-cycle sales role for someone who thrives in a consultative environment, builds lasting relationships at every level of an organization, and brings both the discipline and the emotional intelligence to navigate complex, high-stakes deals. If you are passionate about the security community and want to represent a company that genuinely puts customers first, we want to hear from you.

This is a remote role with candidates residing within the West Region U.S. for regional alignment, with candidates ideally located in the Bay Area or Seattle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from initial qualification through contract closure, managing comple, multi-stakeholder deals with enterprise-level forecast accuracy and consistency.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-level security/risk executives (CISO, VP Security, Chief Risk Officer), technical sponsors (security engineers, architects), and procurement/legal stakeholders throughout extended evaluation and procurement cycles.
  • Drive new business development through strategic prospecting, account planning, and executive-level business case development aligned with our go-to-market strategy and customer security priorities.
  • Navigate complex enterprise procurement processes, including security/compliance reviews, vendor evaluations, legal negotiations, and multi-department consensus-building across Security, IT, Procurement, and Risk teams.
  • Collaborate effectively with sales engineers, product specialists, threat intel SMEs, and integration partners to position our differentiated value in competitive evaluations and deliver tailored solutions.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management with quarterly forecasting, activity tracking, and deal staging within Salesforce, demonstrating consistent accuracy and predictability for leadership.
  • Actively represent the company within security community chapters and build thought leadership presence in the threat intelligence/security operations ecosystem.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of enterprise sales experience with demonstrated track record of consistent quota attainment and successful new business development within competitive, complex enterprise environments
  • Proven success managing complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals with extended sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and competitive RFP/evaluation processes
  • Executive level relationships with ability to identify, map, and engage security decision makers and buyers at the C-level
  • Ability to understand customer security posture, threat landscape, and business drivers; tailoring solutions to customer outcomes
  • Fluency in security operations, threat detection, compliance frameworks, and how threat intelligence fits into broader security stack
  • Experience working alongside security integrators, MSSPs, resellers, and technology partners; ability to collaborate and position for mutual success

Additional Qualifications

  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively cross-functionally
  • Active participation or demonstrated involvement in the security community (e.g., ISSA, ISACA, local chapters) is strongly preferred

Why Join iCOUNTER

This is a rare opportunity to help define a new cybersecurity category while working alongside industry pioneers, the best minds in threat intel, experienced operators, and world-class investors. You will have a direct impact on company strategy, market leadership, and the future of how organizations counter threats across their extended enterprise.

If you are energized by ambiguity, inspired by innovation, and excited to build something category-defining, we want to hear from you.

iCOUNTER is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. iCOUNTER provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

Accommodation: If you need accommodations, reach out to .

Completion of a Background Check is required for employment at iCOUNTER

Benefits: iCOUNTER offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including employer-paid health, dental, vision plans, life and short/long term disability, flexible time off, wellbeing programs, and more.

Salary: Target OTE $300,000 - $320,000

Since 2020, Lisinski Law Firm has served as a dedicated humanitarian immigration practice committed to providing meaningful support to individuals and families seeking safety, stability, and a path forward. We frequently stand with clients who have been turned away elsewhere, offering both advocacy and care. Joining our Firm means becoming part of a team devoted to keeping families together and “Changing as Many Lives as Possible.”

About the Role

The Paralegal Group Leader ensures that all team members joining the Firm have a fantastic experience. They must coordinate with the paralegal Team Leaders consistently to ensure the team is meeting their quality and target outputs. The Paralegal Group Lead develops those beneath them to become stronger leaders and shines at exemplifying our core values and influencing their team to embody them as well.

Your Key Contributions

  • Responsible for up to 3-5 paralegal team leaders (each of whom support up to 5-6 paralegals)
  • Lead team leaders to ensure team members follow standard processes

-Implement and own SOP by which team leader will perform their job duties and work with team leader on any proposed improvements to that SOP

  • Lead team leaders to ensure team meets daily/weekly individual and team quality and output targets

-Review team progress on run charts, error trackers and any other KP trackers daily and immediately raise any issues with TL falling short of targets

-Support the TL in implementing a catch-up plan as needed, solving for root cause when team targets are not met to prevent recurrence

-Work with TL to reach quality targets as set in conjunction with leadership

-Gemba walk with each TL at least 1x per week in team meeting to understand how TL conducts the meeting, tracks performance, provides feedback and tackles problems with their team members

  • Participate in developing and carrying out initiatives to support teams in meeting firm targets and case submission goals

-Work with the TLs to implement any improvement initiatives aims to meet firm quality and output targets and case submission goals

-Gain familiarity with the capacity tracker and discuss with leaders how this plays into firm quality and output targets and submission goals

  • Lead TL through improvement efforts with their team

-Hold regular target review meeting with each TL to discuss reasons quality and output team targets were met and/or not met and the SOP(s) for the team and any proposed or in-test modifications

  • Support TL in implementing and tracking KPIs

-Review run charts, error trackers, TL review logs and any other KPI trackers and hold target review meetings where KPIs drive the discussion

  • Implement and track KPIs related to TL targets and improvement initiatives

-Track the progress of each TL and the TL group as a whole in reaching quality and output goals

  • Provide relief for team leaders as needed

-Cover TL absences and assist as needed in catchup plans if a team member falls short of targets

  • Train and develop new TLs and upkeep training material

-Assist in developing and improving an SOP for onboarding/training and following that SOP

  • Handle HR issues for team leaders

-Time off requests, timecard reviews, feedback reviews

-Assist in developing SOP for handling HR issues and follow that SOP

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to build strong client relationships and manage communications professionally
  • Leadership experience, including mentoring team members, driving accountability, and leading initiatives
  • KPI tracking and reporting experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
  • Knowledge of immigration law and firm procedures
  • Organized
  • Strong performer
  • Independent problem-solver
  • Positive and calm under pressure
  • Open to giving and receiving feedback
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Work Schedule

  • M-F 9 AM - 6 PM EST

Equipment Requirements

*Only added for EOR/Virtual Freelance positions (delete if not)

For PC Users:

  • A modern processor (Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from the last few years)
  • Windows 11 (kept up to date)

For Mac Users:

  • A modern processor (Apple M1 chip or a recent Intel Core i5)
  • A recent macOS (Ventura or newer)

For Everyone:

  • At least 8 GB of memory (RAM) to run applications smoothly
  • A fast hard drive with sufficient available storage

How You'll Benefit

Lisinski Law Firm provides a comprehensive benefits package that supports the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We recognize the importance of health and well-being and are committed to fostering an environment where every team member can feel and perform at their best.

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – including vacation, sick leave, and personal days, consistent with the local country’s requirements.  
  • Paid Holidays –countryspecificpublic holidays. 
  • Locally aligned health benefits – such as medical, dental, vision, disability, and other required national benefits aligned to local laws and norms.  
  • Local payroll in native currency – with all taxes, social contributions, and statutory benefits automatically calculated and handled.  
  • Retirement or pension contributions – based on each country’s legal and cultural standards. 
  • Employee support and compliance protection – including access to local HR experts for questions about laws, culture, or benefits. 

Our Firm

At Lisinski Law Firm, the commitment we show to our clients is matched by how we support and invest in our people. LLF is a place where employees are encouraged by peers, heard by leadership, and strengthened by a genuinely collaborative team culture. Whether you join Marketing, IT, Accounting, Legal, or any other function, your work matters. Every role contributes to meaningful, lasting impact in the lives of those we serve.

Our Values

At Lisinski Law Firm, we are driven by a client obsessed mindset and a commitment to learning, advocacy, efficiency, and nimbleness in everything we do. We work as true team players, delivering creative problem-solving and high-quality service to support families with excellence and care.

raw.description:
About Reunion Marketing

Reunion Marketing is a dynamic and forward-thinking agency specializing in digital marketing for the Automotive industry. We drive success through data-driven strategies and innovative campaign management. Join our team of passionate professionals committed to delivering measurable results for our Automotive Clients.

About the Role

This is not a traditional SEO role.

We’re looking for a highly capable Senior SEO & Content Strategist who thrives at the intersection of SEO, AI-assisted content production, technical execution, and operational ownership. This is a hands-on role for someone who doesn’t just create strategy decks—they execute.

You’ll own organic search execution across a portfolio of clients, taking projects from idea to publish with minimal oversight. One hour you may be diagnosing ranking declines, the next you’re refining AI-generated content, building pages in a CMS, writing schema markup, or optimizing production workflows.

If you enjoy autonomy, solving problems quickly, and building efficient systems in fast-moving environments, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own SEO Execution from Start to Finish

You’ll manage and execute organic search initiatives across multiple client accounts—balancing strategy, production, technical SEO, and delivery.

Lead AI-Assisted Content Production

  • Create and refine SEO-driven content using tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Jasper
  • Build scalable workflows that improve production speed without compromising quality
  • Evaluate AI output critically for accuracy, SEO value, and brand alignment
  • Produce location pages, service pages, blogs, and ad hoc SEO projects at scale

Build & Publish Pages Yourself

  • Work directly inside CMS platforms to build and launch pages
  • Use HTML and CSS to improve structure, readability, UX, and layout quality
  • Implement metadata, internal linking, schema, and on-page SEO best practices during production—not after the fact

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Own SEO production scheduling and workflow coordination
  • Monitor errors, identify bottlenecks, and proactively solve issues before they impact performance
  • Keep projects moving in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner closely with SEO leadership, paid media, social, and operations teams
  • Step in as backup support for SEO leadership when needed
  • Help align organic initiatives with broader marketing and client growth strategies

What You Bring

You’re someone who can think strategically while still enjoying the execution side of the work. You’re resourceful, highly organized, and comfortable owning outcomes independently.

Required Experience

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on SEO execution experience (agency or in-house)
  • Proven experience writing SEO-focused content using AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Jasper
  • Experience building and publishing pages across CMS platforms
  • Strong track record improving rankings, traffic, conversions, or other organic KPIs

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong technical SEO knowledge including indexing, crawlability, schema, and page experience
  • Working proficiency in HTML and CSS
  • Strong familiarity with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMRush, and Sheets/Excel
  • Ability to structure prompts and build AI-assisted workflows effectively
  • Confidence analyzing performance data and translating insights into action

You’ll Excel in This Role If You…

  • Prefer ownership over micromanagement
  • Can move quickly without sacrificing quality
  • Enjoy solving messy operational or technical problems
  • Think beyond templates and standard processes
  • Are naturally proactive and identify risks before they become issues
  • Like building systems that make work smarter and faster

What Success Looks Like

  • Content and pages ship on time and at a high quality standard
  • SEO production runs smoothly and efficiently
  • AI workflows create measurable efficiency gains
  • Organic performance improves consistently across client portfolios
  • Leadership and teammates trust you to own projects independently

Work Environment

  • Fully remote/home office environment
  • Fast-paced, collaborative, high-accountability culture
  • Lean team structure where individual contribution matters

Why This Role Is Different

Most SEO roles separate strategy, content, technical execution, and production into different teams.

This one doesn’t.

You’ll have the opportunity to operate as a true end-to-end SEO strategist and builder—leveraging AI, technical skill, and operational ownership to drive measurable impact for clients.

If that sounds energizing rather than overwhelming, we’d like to talk.

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

What You'll Do
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Recruiter to help scale our team. This role is central to our growth and will partner closely with company leadership to define hiring priorities, shape recruiting strategy, and attract exceptional talent.

  • Own the end-to-end recruitment life cycle across non-technical roles based on your strengths and interests

  • Lead Sourcing Strategy by developing and executing comprehensive sourcing strategies to identify top-tier candidates, balancing speed with quality

  • Partner with leadership on hiring needs and priorities to implement best-in-class talent acquisition strategies and goals that are trackable, accountable, and rooted in data

  • Day to day execution: Screen potential candidates to assess qualifications and fit, advise hiring managers on candidate management, track internal SLAs and timelines, and own communications with candidates

  • Report on key recruiting metrics and suggest actionable changes to leadership to hit our goals

Qualifications & Fit

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a demonstrated ability to independently manage roles end-to-end

  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced environment; early-stage or rapid-growth experience strongly preferred

  • Strong sourcing experience and comfort proactively building pipelines rather than relying solely on inbound

  • Experience using Ashby ATS to manage pipelines, report on metrics, and maintain clean recruiting operations

  • Ownership mentality: You look for opportunities to make an impact and improve processes that will uplevel the team and business as a whole

What We Offer (Full Time Roles Only)

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

raw.description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist Snapshot

Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.

This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel.

You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments.

The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process.

Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket.

We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively.

Position Overview

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent.

You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly.

You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management.

More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform.

Your Core Responsibilities

Talent Sourcing

  • Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles.

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies.

  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles.

  • Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens.

Candidate Qualification

  • Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit.

  • Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords.

  • Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles.

  • Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators.

  • Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process.

Sales Talent Acquisition

  • Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders.

  • Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff.

  • Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network.

  • Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent.

Candidate Experience

  • Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.

  • Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage.

  • Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically.

  • Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract.

Recruiting Operations

  • Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS.

  • Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire.

  • Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages.

  • Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process.

  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve recruiting efficiency.

Hiring & Onboarding Partnership

  • Support offer creation and candidate closing.

  • Help ensure strong candidates remain engaged through acceptance and start date.

  • Partner with the team to identify early indicators of successful hires.

  • Track quality of hire and use performance data to improve future recruiting decisions.

You SHOULD Apply If

  • You have 1+ years of Talent Acquisition, recruiting, or full-cycle recruiting experience.

  • You have experience recruiting salespeople, preferably revenue-generating roles.

  • You know how to source candidates rather than relying exclusively on inbound applicants.

  • You're comfortable conducting candidate screens and making recommendations to hiring managers.

  • You can quickly identify whether someone's experience actually matches what they're claiming.

  • You are highly comfortable talking to salespeople.

  • You understand performance-driven environments and aren't intimidated by metrics.

  • You can manage multiple open roles without losing track of candidates or details.

  • You're organized, responsive, and operationally strong.

  • You're comfortable working in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

  • You can communicate professionally with candidates at every level.

  • You're proactive. If you see a recruiting problem, your instinct is to solve it rather than wait for someone to tell you what to do.

BIG BONUS POINTS

  • You have past sales experience.

  • You have high-ticket sales experience.

  • You've been a setter, closer, AE, sales manager, or sales leader.

  • You've recruited high-ticket closers or setters before.

  • You've worked in coaching, consulting, SaaS, agency, or other performance-driven sales environments.

  • You understand sales compensation structures and can speak intelligently about earning potential with candidates.

  • You have an established network of sales talent.

  • You've recruited for remote sales organizations.

You SHOULD NOT Apply If

  • You only want to work inbound applications.

  • You don't enjoy outbound sourcing.

  • You need every step of your day mapped out for you.

  • You don't like metrics or performance accountability.

  • You're uncomfortable making judgment calls on candidates.

  • You struggle to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • You view recruiting as simply scheduling interviews and forwarding resumes.

  • You don't enjoy talking to people.

  • You're looking for a slow-moving corporate environment with six approval layers before anything gets done.

  • You have never recruited before and are looking for your first opportunity in Talent Acquisition.

Long-Term

You become one of the people Curvion Blue relies on to answer:

"We need five great salespeople. Where are they?"

And your answer is:

"Already working on it."

The Person We're Looking For

We're not looking for someone who simply wants to "work in HR."

We're looking for a talent hunter.

Someone who enjoys the chase.

Someone who can look at a LinkedIn profile and immediately start thinking:

"This person might be good. Let me find out."

You should enjoy talking to people, asking good questions, spotting potential, and figuring out what makes someone tick.

You should be competitive enough to care about winning the search, analytical enough to care about hiring quality, and organized enough to keep the machine running.

If you've sold before, you'll probably have a natural advantage here because you already understand how to build rapport, overcome objections, create urgency, and influence decisions.

If you've sold high-ticket, even better. You already understand the world our candidates operate in.

At Curvion Blue, we're building revenue engines for our clients. That requires exceptional people.

Your job is to help us find them.

Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday

  • 9AM - 6 PM (specific to your time zone)

Compensation Range: $50K - $80K

What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on the quality and accuracy of introductory quantum computing assessments. Evaluating fundamental concepts like superposition, entanglement, and basic Qiskit implementations is critical for creating effective educational materials. Your expertise will help us refine these evaluation standards to ensure they are rigorous and technically sound.

How It Works

During this remote session, you will review a structured JSON dataset containing exam questions, distractors, and grading rubrics. You will audit multiple-choice options for technical correctness and eliminate any ambiguous distractor choices. Additionally, you will verify Qiskit code prompts and add edge test cases to improve the grading rubrics. The task concludes with you submitting a corrected or approved JSON file incorporating your expert feedback.

Who This Is For

We are looking for quantum computing practitioners, researchers, and educators with strong foundational knowledge of the field. We welcome quantum software engineers, physics academics, quantum algorithm developers, and technical curriculum designers. You should be highly familiar with fundamental quantum concepts, logic gates, and basic Qiskit programming.

What You'll Do

  • Audit multiple-choice questions and correct answers for technical accuracy.

  • Identify and eliminate ambiguous distractor choices in the exam options.

  • Verify the accuracy of Qiskit code prompts and their associated grading rubrics.

  • Add edge test cases to evaluate the robustness of the coding questions.

  • Submit a corrected or fully approved JSON file containing the finalized exam paper.

Who Should Apply

  • Professional or academic experience in quantum computing or quantum physics

  • Hands-on familiarity with writing and reviewing Qiskit code

  • Strong understanding of fundamental quantum concepts like superposition, entanglement, and logic gates

  • Comfortable reading and editing structured JSON data

raw.description:
Contexte

Parmi les 8 practices & bureaux de Wavestone, la business unit DC (Digital Customer) accompagne les entreprises françaises et internationales dans les secteurs du Luxe, Retail, Hospitality & Services.

Notre objectif est d’aider nos clients à réussir les transformations majeures de leurs modèles de ventes et de livraisons de produits/services, notamment autour de quatre axes :

  • Digital Makers & Product Design
  • Retail Excellence
  • Supply Chain & Operations (SAP, PLM)
  • Intelligence Artificielle & Data

Forts de 250 consultant.e.s combinant des expertises sectorielles et technologiques uniques, nous sommes en capacité d’intervenir de bout en bout :

  • Sur l’ensemble de la chaine de valeur, de la vente aux opérations (finance, supply chain)
  • Sur l’ensemble des aspects métiers, fonctionnels, applicatifs et technologiques
  • De la stratégie au pilotage de la transformation, en préparant le futur modèle d’opération agile

Nous créons de la valeur de façon durable, grâce à notre Positive Way, en privilégiant toujours la simplicité et le pragmatisme.

Nous sommes indépendants, tout en entretenant de forts liens opérationnels avec les principaux leaders du marché pour rester en permanence à l’état de l’art. 

Dans un environnement où l’innovation technologique s’accélère, la capacité à transformer rapidement une idée en solution opérationnelle est devenue un enjeu stratégique pour les entreprises. L’essor des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour automatiser et accélérer le développement applicatif. Ces solutions promettent de réduire drastiquement le temps de conception et de mise en production, mais leurs performances réelles restent à évaluer.

Le stage s’inscrit dans cette dynamique : tester si les outils IA disponibles fin 2025 permettent de passer efficacement de l’idée à une application web déployable en production, et dans quelle mesure ils peuvent se substituer aux approches traditionnelles ou low-code.

Objectif du stage

Encadré.e par un.e chef.fe de projet expérimenté.e, vous aurez pour mission de réaliser un benchmark opérationnel des solutions IA orientées développement applicatif. Ce benchmark se déroulera en deux étapes :

  • Analyse théorique : étude comparative des principales solutions du marché (fonctionnalités, interopérabilité, coûts, contraintes techniques).
  • Expérimentation pratique : sélection de 4 solutions pour concevoir et développer une application web avec chacune d’elles. L’application réalisée sera choisie en fonction des besoins internes ou d’avant-vente (exemple : outil support pour un événement, maquette fonctionnelle pour un projet). Outre le développement, ce sera aussi l’occasion de mettre à l’épreuve / développer vos compétences UX

À l’issue de ces travaux, vous produirez une analyse critique de la qualité du code généré, des performances et de la facilité de déploiement, afin de formuler des recommandations concrètes sur les meilleures solutions à adopter.

Une question complémentaire pourra être explorée : les solutions IA peuvent-elles remplacer les plateformes low-code en termes de rapidité, sécurité et intégration dans un SI d’entreprise ?

En bref, l’objectif est d’avoir développé à l’issu du stage une compréhension fine de comment l’IA permet d’être efficient dans le développement informatique, et une conviction sur les meilleurs outils à utiliser.

En parallèle, vous serez pleinement intégré.e à la vie interne du cabinet et pourrez contribuer, selon vos appétences, à :

  • L’animation et le développement des offres de l’expertise Supply Chain ;
  • La rédaction de contenus à destination de nos blogs et supports de communication ;
  • Le développement de nos assets internes (Shake'Up, CréaDesk, Research & Knowledge Center) ;
  • Les initiatives de recrutement, de relations écoles et de formation ;
  • La mise en œuvre de la stratégie RSE de Wavestone.

Travaux à réaliser

Le ou la stagiaire contribuera activement à l’enrichissement de l’offre interne de Wavestone autour de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel :

  1. Réaliser un état des lieux du marché : identification des solutions IA orientées développement web, analyse de leurs caractéristiques et positionnement.
  2. Élaborer un benchmark théorique : comparaison des avantages et limites des solutions (rapidité, qualité du code, interopérabilité avec outils comme Figma, coût).

  4. Évaluer la qualité des livrables : analyse du code généré, robustesse, maintenabilité, sécurité et facilité de déploiement.

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Software Engineer.

About the job

This position is needed to lead the planning, design, development, and testing of large-scale software systems and new product capabilities, including cloud and internet-facing services. You’ll set technical direction, drive delivery using modern engineering practices, and ensure what we ship is secure, compliant, and production-ready. You’ll partner closely with product and engineering teams to turn requirements into reliable, high-quality software.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead architecture and system design for complex, distributed software systems; guide teams toward scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Design, implement, and review high-quality code for core services, APIs, platforms, and/or user-facing applications.
  • Translate business goals into technical roadmaps, identify tradeoffs, and align stakeholders on solution direction.
  • Improve system resiliency, latency, throughput, and cost efficiency; establish SLOs/SLAs and operational practices.
  • Drive standards for coding, testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and documentation; champion automation and quality.
  • Partner with engineering managers, staff engineers, and product leaders to coordinate delivery across multiple teams.
  • Coach and mentor engineers at all levels; lead design reviews, incident postmortems, and technical deep dives.
  • Identify technical risks early (security, scalability, compliance) and drive mitigation plans.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 12+ years of experience designing and developing highly-available, high-scale, secure, mission critical native cloud enterprise SaaS applications in Java, Go or Python.
  • Knowledge of architectural patterns and archetypes for building mature services, especially for distributed and multi-regional deployments.
  • Excellent abilities in high level service design - modeling interfaces and internals in a proper modular, composable, and extensible way.
  • Experience with AWS, GCP or other public cloud infrastructure platforms. Multi-region deployment is a plus.
  • Experience building distributed systems at scale based on microservices architecture.
  • Extensive experience with REST API design and implementation.
  • Experience working with data architecture such as Clickhouse, Lakehouse, Snowflake
  • Experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and caches.
  • Familiarity with streaming systems such as Kafka, Flink, Spark
  • Experience with container technologies - Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Experience implementing modern automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. Develop, Test, Deploy your code.
  • Strong expertise in solving complex production issues

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India .

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

raw.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

RISC-V CPU RTL owner will play a key role in developing next-generation CPU design. This position requires a deep understanding of CPU design including Architecture, RTL, Design Verification, Physical Design Flow. The ideal candidate will drive the unit specification, RTL design, and unit verification.

This role is Remote, based out of The United States.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • RISC-V CPU Unit Microarchitecture Specification: Define and develop microarchitecture specifications for the assigned unit (branch predictor, rename, instruction scheduling, vector execution, load/store, vector load/store support). The specification includes not only design, but also comprehensive analysis / strategy for verification and PPA (power, performance, area) closure.
  • RISC-V CPU Core Unit RTL Design: The candidate will be responsible for the quality of RTL including design verification and PPA closure. This includes writing RTL, reviewing / refining unit verification environment, applying right RTL optimization to control PPA.
  • AI Assisted Design Adaption: To maximize the team’s output, the candidate actively uses AI tools to accelerate the CPU design process.
  • Mentoring Junior Engineers: depending on a seniority of the engineer, the engineer may mentor junior members in the team.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Proven track record of designing high-performance CPU RTL for x86, Arm, POWER, SPARC, or RISC-V.
  • Deep understanding of design verification strategy and trade-offs for verification methodology (simulation, formal, various checkers, etc…)
  • Deep understanding of CPU microarchitecture and PPA trade-off.
  • Basic understanding of RISC-V Architecture including V-extension is preferred.
  • Proficiency in hardware description languages (HDLs) such as Verilog, SystemVerilog or VHDL.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and across multiple disciplines.

Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position: Marketing Operations Manager

Location: Remote

Overview:

We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and data-driven Marketing Operations Manager to own the reporting, measurement, and operational intelligence that enable Marketing leadership to make informed business decisions. This role serves as the operational bridge between Marketing, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Data Engineering — translating business needs into scalable reporting frameworks, standardized operating processes, and AI-enabled insights across multiple business units. This is a data- and systems-oriented role: the ideal candidate brings strong technical and analytical fluency, not a marketing-generalist background, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Marketing Performance & Analytics

  • Analyze Marketing performance across the funnel, pipeline, marketing-originated bookings, and campaign effectiveness to identify trends, opportunities, and risks, in close collaboration with Marketing and Data teams.
  • Ensure data accuracy and timeliness across automated performance scorecarding for lead-to-opportunity conversion, marketing-originated bookings, and marketing return on investment (ROMI), across all in-scope business units.
  • Analyze marketing budget performance and spend attainment to support planning and investment decisions.

Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Own the Marketing reporting suite within the centralized BI/reporting layer, ensuring reports remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with business needs.
  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to define reporting requirements, prioritize enhancements, and validate completed work through business acceptance testing (QA/UAT).
  • Develop and maintain standardized reporting documentation, metric definitions, and reporting logic.

Marketing Measurement & Operations

  • Develop and refine measurement frameworks for campaign performance, attribution, lead scoring, pipeline source-mix tracking, and marketing ROI.
  • Create and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve marketing operations efficiency, consistency, and scalability across business units.
  • Optimize lead enrichment and lead routing processes to ensure data accuracy and seamless marketing-to-sales handoffs, including qualification standards prior to sales conversion.
  • Design and manage GTM cadences to align Marketing, Sales Development, and Sales teams for effective execution and pipeline growth.

AI & Reporting Automation

  • Support the development and operationalization of AI-enabled reporting and business insights for Marketing.
  • Assist in the design and continuous improvement of automated reporting processes and AI-generated summaries.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Data Engineering to identify opportunities where AI can improve reporting efficiency and decision-making.

Sales Development (SDR) Operations Support

  • Serve as the primary operations support for the sales development (SDR) function — reporting, activity data, and program cadences — partnering with Sales Operations, which retains ownership of SDR compensation and quota administration.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, and Data Engineering to ensure reporting and operational processes support business objectives.
  • Coordinate implementation of reporting enhancements and process improvements across multiple stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted operational partner to Marketing leadership by translating data into actionable business recommendations.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in Marketing Operations, Marketing Analytics, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence, or a related analytical/technical field.
  • Strong data analytics and BI reporting skills, including experience working in a centralized BI/reporting layer (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI) rather than direct CRM access, plus advanced Excel modeling.
  • Proficiency in marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot) and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Strong understanding of demand generation metrics (lead qualification conversion, marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-originated bookings), attribution, and marketing ROI.
  • Experience partnering with technical teams to define business requirements, validate reporting solutions, and improve analytics capabilities.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience managing multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration with sales, operations, and business unit leadership.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights for both business-unit-level and centralized stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a centralized Marketing Operations or Revenue Operations organization supporting multiple business units.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with SQL or the ability to work effectively with Data Engineering teams on reporting requirements.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted reporting, business intelligence automation, or generative AI tools.
  • Exposure to sales development (SDR) operations — activity reporting, tooling, and program cadences.

What We're Looking For:

The ideal candidate is a curious, highly analytical, and results-oriented professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, process, and technology — not a marketer who moved into operations. They are comfortable partnering with both business and technical stakeholders, translating ambiguous questions into reporting and operational solutions, and are excited to contribute to the evolution of Marketing Operations through automation and AI.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

raw.excerpt: About UsDLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation.
raw.description:
About Us

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.

Overview

We are currently seeking a Senior Data Manager/SAS programmer who, in collaboration with lead data managers and programmers, will provide both data management and statistical programming support for federally-funded and commercially-funded clinical research and epidemiological studies. You will be part of a multi-disciplinary team that includes other data managers and programmers, epidemiologists, and operations staff. You will play a critical role in the collection and management of data for these studies by developing databases, workflows, and reports to support the full lifecycle of a study. You will lead the design and implementation of complex data processing programs and automated data management workflows that support clinical research and public health programs. This position is responsible for building scalable data management systems, streamlining data exchange, and implementing robust quality assurance processes to maximize data integrity. This position offers many opportunities for professional development, innovation, and collaboration across disciplines.

Responsibilities

  • Lead data management activities for clinical, observational, and epidemiologic research studies from study start-up through database closeout, ensuring data are complete, accurate, and fit for purpose.
  • Design, develop, and maintain study databases and data management processes, including data collection instruments, validation rules, data specifications, data cleaning procedures, and data transfer processes.
  • Perform advanced SAS programming to clean, transform, validate, integrate, and manage complex research datasets and develop reusable and automated programming solutions.
  • Develop and execute data quality and validation procedures, including programmed data checks, data reconciliation, discrepancy resolution, and independent QC of datasets, programs, and deliverables.
  • Integrate and reconcile data from multiple sources, ensuring consistency, completeness, traceability, and appropriate documentation of data transformations and decisions.
  • Develop and maintain study datasets, reports, extracts, and data releases to support investigators, statisticians, and other study stakeholders, including interim data cuts and final study deliverables.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data management and programming staff, including work planning, risk identification, technical guidance, and promotion of consistent programming and QC practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and ensure compliance with study requirements, organizational SOPs, applicable regulatory and privacy requirements, and established data management and programming standards.

Qualifications

  • B.S. degree in computer science, health sciences, or other related field; seven or more years of experience with programming and data management in health research. OR,
  • M.S. degree in computer science, health sciences, or other related field; five or more years of experience with programming and data management in health research.
  • Advanced SAS programming capabilities, including extensive experience with DATA and PROC steps, macro programming, data transformation and integration, complex data validation, and development of efficient, reusable programming solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex research data, preferably within clinical, observational, epidemiologic, or other biomedical research studies.
  • Strong understanding of the full research data lifecycle, including study start-up, database development, data collection, data cleaning, reconciliation, quality control, data delivery, and database closeout.
  • Experience integrating and reconciling data from multiple sources, with the ability to identify and resolve complex data issues while maintaining data integrity, traceability, and appropriate documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex data management and programming activities, including defining technical approaches, managing competing priorities, identifying risks, and delivering high-quality work within established timelines.
  • Strong quality assurance and attention to detail, including experience developing and implementing QC procedures and independently reviewing data, programming code, datasets, and other technical deliverables.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills, with the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary research teams, communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences, and provide guidance to less experienced data management and programming staff.
  • Experience with additional programming and data technologies, such as R, Python, SQL, database architecture and development, Git or other version control systems, APIs, and/or other tools used to develop efficient, scalable, and automated research data workflows is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with clinical research data standards and regulations (e.g., NIH Common Data Elements, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, GCP, or FAIR principles) is highly desirable.

Basic Compensation: $110,000 - $140,000 yearly salary

The salary range listed reflects what we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The final offer may vary based on skills, experience, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. Additional compensation may include performance incentives and program-specific awards. We do not use salary history to determine compensation, in line with applicable law.

Benefits

DLH Corp offers our employees an excellent benefits package, including Personal Time Off (PTO), medical, dental, vision, supplemental life with AD&D, short and long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, parental leave, legal services, and more. We want our employees to save for their future; therefore, we offer a 401(k) Retirement Plan, which includes a matching component. DLH is dedicated to your career development, providing training to help drive success, with access to our best-in-class e-learning suite for formal and informal learning, professional and technical certification preparation, and education assistance at accredited institutions.

EEO

DLH Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. DLH will provide reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities and disabled Veterans who need assistance to apply.

POSITION SUMMARY
Unique Interpreters, LLC is seeking qualified Spanish-English Interpreters/Translators to provide remote, on-demand interpretation and document translation support for client engagements involving sensitive, trauma-informed conversations. Interpreters will support phone-based interpretation sessions, ensuring accurate, culturally sensitive, and confidential communication between English and Spanish speaking parties.
This is a part-time, remote, independent contractor position ideal for experienced interpreters seeking flexible, meaningful work.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide accurate, real-time consecutive and/or simultaneous interpretation during phone sessions between English and Spanish speaking parties. Translate written documents, forms, and correspondence between English and Spanish as needed. Maintain strict confidentiality of all client, case, and personal information encountered during sessions. Interpret in a neutral, professional, and trauma-informed manner, particularly during sensitive conversations involving families and children. Document session details (date, time, duration) for accurate billing and quality tracking. Adhere to professional interpreter ethics standards, including accuracy, impartiality, and confidentiality.

Current interpreter certification required — one of the following: Certified Medical Interpreter (CMI), Certified Court Interpreter, National Board of Certification for Medical Interpreters (NBCMI), Certification Commission for Healthcare Interpreters (CCHI), or equivalent state/federal interpreter certification. Reliable high-speed internet connection, computer/smartphone, and headset suitable for remote interpretation. Ability to pass a background screening as required by client contracts. Strong professional communication skills and ability to maintain composure during emotionally sensitive conversations. Ability to work independently and manage a flexible, part-time schedule.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience interpreting in social services, child welfare, immigration, healthcare, or legal settings. Experience working with vulnerable populations, including families and minors. Availability for both scheduled sessions and short notice on-demand requests. Languages of particular value: English, Spanish, Haitian Creole, Hindi, Mandarin Chinese, Russian/Croatian.

GTM Associate

London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for A-players to help build the commercial engine and take on a revenue-driving seat. You will be a clients’ very first touchpoint with Vega; running outbound, supporting growth and marketing initiatives, and building systems that support hyper-growth.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by Alexis Augier, a former investor at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo (who were a client before becoming an investor), Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Be a client’s first touchpoint with Vega - this means being a credible counterpart to senior people at multi-billion dollar managers

  • Work directly with the Head of Strategy and Growth and the CEO to find angles and drive deals forward from start to close

  • Own top-of-funnel pipeline generation: targeting, outbound, qualification, and building the systems around this motion

  • Help build the commercial playbook as you go: taking an operational and systematic lens to turn learnings into a discipline that the team can follow

  • Support the broader growth surface: events, partnerships, content, and marketing

What we look for:

  • 2+ years in investor relations / finance, MBB, or a commercial/operational role at a fast-paced startup

  • Experience in private markets, particularly around investor relations workflows, is a strong plus

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills, as well as analytical instincts

  • Genuine tolerance for repetition and rejection - this is some of the highest impact work you can do for the company, but it’s also high volume and requires scrappiness

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills when interfacing with clients who have a very high standard for output and attention to detail

  • Creativity and a bias to action, particularly when supporting with broader growth/marketing topics

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more
