raw.description:
Strategy & Operations (1-3 YoE)

London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for multi-disciplinary A players who have what it takes to build a business from the ground up. We hire people who are already high-performers in MBB or finance/investing, but still have the itch to do more. This role will sit in the CEO Office, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Growth, working across the highest strategic priorities in the business.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by Alexis Augier, a former investor at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo (who were a client before becoming an investor), Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Context-switch across strategy, go-to-market, operations, external comms, special projects, and investor relations

  • Be handed projects from Day 1, including representing Vega externally

  • Sit in the CEO Office, reporting directly to the Head of Strategy & Growth

  • Work closely with the Product & Growth and Engineering teams - strategy is not a silo at Vega

What we look for:

  • Required: 1-3 years of experience in MBB or finance/investing at a Tier 1 institution.

  • Whilst stellar training is essential, this is not all that we look for and not everyone with a background in MBB/investing will do well. This role is for people who have high standards of excellence for themselves, along with the risk tolerance and ambition to go beyond the comfort zone and structure of a larger institution.

  • Low ego, and a willingness to get stuck in; this role will allow you to do career-accelerating things that you might otherwise wait decades to do - but there will also be gruntwork. Everyone at Vega, including leadership, handles both.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills. You will need to think and explain complex concepts and communicate them internally and externally with different audiences.

Why join us?

  • Get a first-hand view, and real ownership of, everything that it takes to operate a fast-growing business

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

This role provides expert EHS leadership across a variety of operations, processes and emerging technologies, ensuring safe, compliant, and reliable solutions. By partnering with key stakeholders, the position strengthens organizational resilience through consistent hazard‑control strategies, technical safety communications, Management of Change governance support, and participation in safety incident investigations and review boards. Ultimately, it enables innovation while reducing risk, advancing compliance, and reinforcing a strong safety culture that supports mission‑critical processes.

What You Will Do

  • Provide subject matter expertise on emerging technologies—including but not limited to lithium ion batteries, high voltage systems, automation/robotics, and novel materials—and how associated risks intersect with EHS compliance and safe operation.

  • Serve as the primary EHS liaison to Product Safety and the Office of the Chief Engineer ensuring collaboration and alignment on EHS compliance

  • Partner closely with Engineering Lab Management to ensure safe work processes.

  • Coordinate EHS support of Failure Review Boards (FRB), providing independent safety oversight, input on root cause analysis, and recommendations for corrective actions.

  • Coordinate EHS support of Engineering Safety Review Boards, collaborating with engineering leadership on risk identification, mitigation, and acceptance.

  • Support EHS Management of Change (MOC) process, including review of new processes, equipment, test setups, materials, and facility modifications.

  • Develop and support EHS bulletins, safety communications, and incident related learnings to be shared across engineering and operational organizations.

  • Support cross site and cross functional EHS program implementation, ensuring consistency of hazard control strategies and alignment with OSHA, NFPA, ANSI, military standards, and Raytheon requirements.

  • Conduct or support investigations involving emerging technologies; collaborate on root cause analysis and corrective action development.

  • Provide guidance to engineering teams on hazard analyses, risk assessments, and mitigations.

  • Support internal audits, customer audits, and corporate assessments covering engineering, laboratory, and high hazard operations.

  • Mentor EHS and engineering personnel on safety engineering concepts, control methodologies, and regulatory interpretations.

  • Will travel domestically and internationally approximately 25%

  • Located near a major Raytheon locations, e.g., Andover, MA; McKinney, TX; Tucson, AZ

Qualifications You Must Have

  • Typically requires: A University Degree or equivalent experience and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience, or An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years’ experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of combined experience in EHS, systems engineering, product safety, or engineering operations.

  • U.S. Citizenship is required. Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Master’s degree in Engineering, EHS, or related technical discipline.

  • Experience supporting or participating in Engineering Safety Boards, Failure Review Boards, or design reviews.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting engineering organizations, laboratories, or product development teams.

  • Experience with OSHA 1910, NFPA standards, ANSI, and applicable engineering safety standards.

  • Experience performing and reviewing hazard analyses, FMEAs, fault trees, or similar engineering risk assessment methodologies.

  • Experience working with high hazard technologies such as high voltage, energy storage systems, automation/robotics, or energetic systems.

  • Experience developing Management of Change processes or serving as an MOC reviewer.

  • Experience developing incident communications, safety bulletins, and technical safety advisories.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional technical teams without direct authority.

  • Experience with emerging technologies such as Li ion battery system safety, robotics safety (ISO 10218/TS 15066), high voltage electrical safety (NFPA 70E), or automation/AI driven test systems.

  • Professional health and safety certifications such as the CSP or CIH.

raw.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
raw.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

Join us in one of our most critical member-facing roles, inspiring behavior change and motivating members to adopt new behaviors and improve their health. As a Twin Health Coach, you make a difference in people's lives every day by providing guidance, support, education, and encouragement to empower your members seeking to prevent and reverse chronic metabolic diseases and improve their overall health.

This is a data- and AI-driven coaching model, not an independent private-practice style of coaching. Your day-to-day priorities, member outreach, and session focus are generated by the Twin platform from continuous data streams — CGM, weight, sleep, movement, and app engagement — and your role is to interpret those insights and deliver them with empathy and motivational skill, not to build an independent care plan from scratch. You'll follow standardized SOPs and escalation pathways, lean on nurses, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants for clinical needs, and work within structured, time-boxed sessions rather than open-ended ones.

This role is a great fit if you naturally help people take on difficult things, understand that habit change is hard, and are skilled in behavioral tools that activate people to change — and if you also genuinely enjoy working inside a structured, metrics-driven, technology-forward environment where the coaching model, caseload, and tools are standardized and evolve quickly as we scale.

This role is not a fit if you're looking for the autonomy of independent or contract coaching — self-set hours, a capped or self-managed caseload, or full latitude to design your own coaching approach. It's built for coaches who want structure and a technology-integrated practice.

The schedule for this position is Monday - Friday, some evenings. This is a W-2, employee-model role with a fixed schedule and team coverage obligations.

A Day in the Life

  • Back-to-back 15- and 30-minute video coaching sessions across a high-volume, uncapped caseload
  • Reviewing AI-surfaced member data (glucose trends, weight, sleep, engagement) before and during sessions to guide the conversation
  • Daily AI-assisted member rounding between scheduled visits, plus progress notes and chats completed within 24 business hours
  • Following SOPs for coaching structure, documentation, and escalation — with limited discretion to deviate from the standardized model
  • Adapting to frequent changes in tools, protocols, and schedules as Twin scales

Responsibilities

  • Onboard, activate, and manage members as part of a seamless coaching experience
  • Conduct 15-minute and 30-minute virtual coaching sessions via video or phone to engage members in setting goals, managing their care, and staying motivated on their journey to self-efficacy — completing the full arc of education, motivation, and data review within these time-boxed windows
  • Motivate, coach, and provide exceptional service and support to members to achieve health goals as designated by the Twin app
  • Provide general education on healthy eating principles, meal planning basics, and lifestyle strategies — without crossing into Medical Nutrition Therapy or individualized therapeutic nutrition
  • Use AI-powered tools and other resources as the primary basis for member support, metrics-driven insights, and coaching direction
  • Use AI-powered tools to support daily member rounding in addition to scheduled visits, and complete progress notes and chats within 24 business hours
  • Provide feedback on member metrics including weight, continuous glucose monitoring, sleep, movement, adherence to nutrition guidance, and app engagement, identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Strictly adhere to Standard Operating Procedures for member management, session structure, and escalations.
  • Collaborate closely with coaching team colleagues, providers, registered nurses, and operations teams to drive a seamless member experience
  • Participate in ongoing pilot programs and support additional programs as needed, including new tools or workflow changes
  • Participate in collecting member testimonials to support partner success needs
  • Act as a team player, providing coverage for weekend and holiday on-call responsibilities (approximately 2–4x per year) and unplanned PTO visit coverage
  • Maintain a high-volume, uncapped caseload that will fluctuate based on business needs
  • Maintain flexibility to work any shift (at least 2 evening shifts per week) or change shifts based on business needs
  • Complete additional duties as assigned
  • Maintain a HIPAA-compliant remote work environment and reliable internet connectivity sufficient to conduct uninterrupted video-based member visits

Productivity

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment with competing priorities
  • Demonstrate strong time management, staying within allotted session lengths rather than routinely extending visits
  • Consistently meet or exceed productivity and quality benchmarks, including session-time adherence
  • Work autonomously within your day-to-day tasks while remaining fully aligned with team goals, SOPs, and operational standards
  • Adapt quickly to evolving tools, processes, and business needs

Communication

  • Clear, confident communicator across member and internal interactions
  • Strong team player who collaborates effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deliver clear, concise communication
  • Ability to balance efficiency with empathy in every interaction, including within time-boxed sessions
  • Skilled in de-escalation and handling challenging conversations with professionalism
  • Communicate effectively across multiple channels (phone, video, chat, email)
  • Provide clear insights and updates to team members, leadership, and cross-functional partners

Human-Centered Service & Hospitality

  • Thrives in a collaborative team environment
  • Passionate about member success and skilled in the art of having difficult conversations
  • Open to learning from constructive feedback, including feedback on adapting to new tools or process changes
  • Measurable track record of member satisfaction and understanding of NPS
  • Passion for Twin's purpose to transform lives by empowering people to reverse, prevent, and improve chronic metabolic diseases
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in a metabolic health coaching role or dietitian setting
  • Demonstrated comfort and enthusiasm blending motivational interviewing and behavior-change coaching with metrics-driven, AI-informed direction — this is core to the role, not a supplemental skill
  • Proficient in navigating complex technology, including the remote member app, AI systems, and internal dashboards, with the ability to learn new tools quickly
  • Demonstrated experience managing a high-volume, uncapped caseload, or clear ability and willingness to do so
  • Comfortable operating within a fixed schedule, standardized SOPs, and a structured coaching model
  • Open mindset; flexible and adaptable to frequent process, tool, and schedule changes
  • Fluency in Spanish is a definite plus!

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience and comfort supporting cardiometabolic conditions (T2D, pre-diabetes, obesity)
  • Experience thriving in a high-growth, quickly changing environment (startup experience), including comfort with ambiguity and frequent change
  • Prior experience maintaining a high-volume, uncapped caseload
  • Experience and enthusiasm for delivering back-to-back coaching via video calls
  • Prior experience in a W-2, employee-model coaching or clinical role (rather than solely independent/1099 contractor work)
  • Strong computer skills (Google Workspace, Slack, EHR) and ability to work from a computer for extended periods
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $70,000 annually.

[We show compassion to heal minds.]

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

raw.description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
As a Robotics AI Engineer, you will work at the intersection of learning and hardware, training and deploying policies that run on Asimov in the real world. This is not a research role in the traditional sense. You will be expected to get results on physical robots, not just in simulation, and to iterate fast when things break. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams to close the loop between training and deployment.

What You Will Do

  • Design and train RL and imitation learning policies for locomotion, manipulation, or whole-body control

  • Run experiments on physical hardware and close the sim-to-real gap through systematic debugging and domain adaptation

  • Build and maintain simulation environments and data pipelines that support fast policy iteration

  • Instrument robot deployments and analyze failure modes to feed improvements back into training

  • Collaborate with hardware and firmware engineers to understand physical constraints and improve policy robustness

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong foundations in reinforcement learning or imitation learning, with hands-on experience training policies that run on real systems

  • Comfort working directly with robots, not just simulators

  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with standard RL/ML frameworks (JAX, PyTorch, IsaacGym/IsaacLab, MuJoCo, or similar)

  • An empirical, debugging-first mindset, you care about what actually works on hardware

  • Ability to move fast and context-switch between research problems and engineering tasks

Nice to Have

  • Prior work on humanoid or legged robot platforms

  • Experience with sim-to-real transfer techniques (domain randomization, system identification, noise injection)

  • Contributions to open-source robotics projects

  • Background in control theory, trajectory optimization, or dynamics

Why Join Menlo
The policies you train do not sit in a notebook. They run on a real humanoid, in the real world, on short feedback loops. You will see your work move physical hardware within days, not quarters. You will collaborate directly with the hardware, firmware, and infrastructure teams, with high visibility and real stakes, and everything you can open-source, you will. If you want to build the systems that turn software into physical labor, this is where it happens.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

Tech Stack

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

This job is what Jerry is all about: helping our customers take care of their most important assets, their car and home, with the kind of warmth and speed they didn't expect from an insurance company.

Car and home are people’s most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai is building the first app to help people manage it all.

The work is fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented, and fully remote. A few things our team members love about working at Jerry:

  • Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving.

  • Competitive wage and benefits (medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match, paid vacation time).

  • Stock equity (stock options) — we're a tech startup, and you own a piece of what you're building.

  • Flexible scheduling: a 5-day, 8-hour or a 4-day, 10-hour work week.

  • Fully remote, with work equipment provided.

  • A career path in one of the largest industries in the world — insurance. We pay for your P&C insurance license if you don’t have one yet.

  • And, importantly, the colleagues you work alongside. Ask our team what they value most and the answer is almost always the same: the people and the culture. Jerry is full of people who take their work seriously and take helping each other just as seriously.

This role runs on two paths (sales and service). You don't have to know yet whether you're a sales person or a service person. We will figure this out together through the interview process.

As a member in the Customer Operations team, some of your responsibilities could include:

  • Taking great care of our customers. Our team members don't just answer the question asked — they catch the thing the customer didn't know to ask about. A coverage gap. A discount they qualify for. A renewal about to spike.

  • Answering inbound calls from customers shopping auto, home, motorcycle, and other policies, and from policyholders who need something changed.

  • Getting deep on the product. With a large panel of insurance companies to work from, knowing which one fits which customer is the craft of this job. Our app evolves constantly too, and knowing it inside out makes you the person customers trust to navigate it.

  • Problem solving to remove barriers between a customer and the right coverage.

  • Processing service requests — vehicles, drivers, lienholders, policy documents.

  • Making the product better. Tell us what you're hearing. The feedback loop here is short enough that you'll see your suggestions ship.

Who you are:

  • Prior work experience in customer service, sales, or hospitality is a plus, but not required

  • Genuinely friendly and positive attitude and willingness to work as a team

  • Strong work ethic

  • Strong problem solving skills

  • Strong communication skills

Compensation and perks:

  • Sales: Hourly wage of $19.00 - 21.00 plus uncapped commissions *Our most successful team members typically earn $100,000+ per year.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. About Jerry.ai

Your car and your home are your most expensive assets. And for most people, these aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

Jerry is building the first AI agent to manage all your physical assets. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

The Data Engineering team at Imprint builds the foundation that enables teams and systems across the company to understand, trust, and use data. We own the core data platform, development patterns, and standards behind Imprint's enterprise data warehouse, partnering closely with Infrastructure and with teams across the business.

As Imprint scales, one of our biggest data challenges is turning an increasingly complex business into data that is consistent, understandable, and easy to use by machines or people. Doing that well requires great analytics engineering: clear models of the business, strong definitions and abstractions, and systems that make high-quality data development repeatable.

We don't believe the answer is simply adding more Data Engineers. We want to build a platform that gives domain experts across Imprint the tools and guardrails to contribute safely and independently—allowing us to dramatically increase the pace of analytics engineering without making Data Engineering a bottleneck.

We're looking for a Data Engineering Manager to lead this next phase of our Data Engineering organization. You will build and develop a high-performing team, raise the bar for analytics engineering, and create the platform and development model that allow high-quality data development to scale across Imprint.

This is a people leadership role for someone with deep technical judgment. You won't carry an individual contributor roadmap, but you should be comfortable getting into the details, challenging assumptions, and helping the team reason from first principles about data modeling, architecture, and engineering practices.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead an exceptional Data Engineering team. Hire great engineers, coach and develop the team, grow senior technical leaders, set a high performance bar, and create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Use AI to increase both speed and quality. Develop and implement a point of view on how AI can improve the full analytics engineering lifecycle, from stakeholder engagement, team management, to design and development.

  • Set the technical direction for Data Engineering. Bring strong opinions grounded in experience while encouraging first-principles thinking. Guide architectural decisions and ensure the team builds systems that are simple, scalable, reliable, and appropriate for the problems we're solving.

  • Partner across the company. Work closely with Infrastructure, Analytics, Data Science, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams to understand how the business works, define clear ownership, and build a data ecosystem that enables teams to move faster and make better decisions.

  • Shape the future of the Data organization. Partner with the Head of Data on organizational design, hiring, roadmap prioritization, and the investments needed to support Imprint's continued growth.

Our Data Engineering priorities include:

  • Make Imprint's data legible. Lead the evolution of our enterprise data warehouse into a clear, consistent, and trusted representation of how Imprint's business works. Ensure important business concepts have well-designed models, clear definitions, and intuitive relationships that make our data easier to understand and use.

  • Raise the bar for analytics engineering. Establish strong principles and patterns for data modeling, transformation, testing, documentation, and ownership across our dbt and Snowflake environment. Create the technical standards that allow our data models to remain coherent as the business grows more complex.

  • Scale analytics engineering beyond the Data Engineering team. Create a development model where domain experts can turn their knowledge into high-quality, reusable data models without Data Engineering sitting in the critical path. Define the right boundaries, abstractions, review processes, and ownership model to make distributed contribution successful.

  • Build the platform that makes this possible. Partner closely with Infrastructure to create the tooling, workflows, and guardrails that make contributing to our enterprise data warehouse fast and safe. Make the right way the easiest way.

What We Look For

  • Experience introducing AI-assisted workflows at scale.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup, fintech, or another environment where data correctness and reliability are critical.

  • A track record of building and leading high-performing data or analytics engineering teams, including hiring exceptional talent, developing engineers, managing performance, and growing senior technical leaders.

  • Deep expertise in analytics engineering with dbt, with experience turning complex business domains into data models that are understandable, reusable, and trusted.

  • Strong technical judgment. You can evaluate data models and architecture, identify unnecessary complexity, challenge your team's thinking, and provide direction without needing to personally implement every solution.

  • Strong SQL fluency and enough familiarity with Python and modern software engineering practices to engage deeply with the team's technical work.

  • The ability to move comfortably between strategy and detail, pairing strong opinions with intellectual curiosity and first-principles thinking.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Director Payer Marketing

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will be responsible for developing and executing the payer-facing commercial strategy that enables broad and sustainable access for the company’s products and services. This leader shapes the payer value story, drives payer/customer engagement strategy, and partners cross-functionally with Market Access, Account Management, HEOR/Medical, Pricing & Contracting, Product Marketing, and Sales to improve coverage.

This role is ideal for an experienced market access marketer and people leader who can translate clinical, economic, and real-world evidence into compelling payer narratives; build differentiated segmentation and messaging; and deliver omnichannel campaigns and tools that support payer decision-makers (health plans, PBMs, IDNs/health systems, specialty pharmacy, Medicaid, Medicare, and employer groups).

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership

  • Own and evolve the payer marketing strategy aligned to overall brand strategy, access goals, and corporate priorities across the Amgen priorities.
  • Lead development of the payer value proposition and supporting messages across customer segments for prioritized brands.
  • Serve as the commercial “voice of payer” across the organization—bringing forward insights, trends, and competitive implications.
  • Manage and mentor a high-performing payer marketing team; set clear goals, development plans, and operating rhythms.
  • Establish robust payer/customer insight generation, including primary/secondary research, advisory boards, and competitive monitoring.
  • Identify key access barriers and leverage points; translate insights into measurable marketing objectives and tactics.

Value Communication & Content Development

  • Lead creation and governance of payer-facing materials and programs, including:
    • Payer value decks and formulary kits
    • AMCP dossiers and supporting modules (as applicable)
    • Budget impact models / cost calculators (in collaboration with HEOR)
    • Clinical and economic evidence summaries (within promotional/non-promotional guidelines)
    • P&T committee support tools and pull-through resources
    • Account-specific customization frameworks
  • Ensure all payer materials are accurate, compliant, and aligned with Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR) and applicable industry codes.

Omnichannel Marketing

  • Design and execute account-based marketing (ABM) approaches for priority plans/accounts, enabling field teams with tailored messaging and content.
  • Orchestrate omnichannel payer engagement (field enablement, email, webinars, thought leadership, congress presence, digital channels, and partner ecosystems).

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate closely with:
    • Pricing & Contracting Strategy to ensure marketing narratives support contracting strategy and access pathways
    • HEOR/Medical/CfOR to translate evidence plans into customer-ready value stories
    • Trade/Distribution (where relevant) to support specialty pharmacy and channel strategies
    • Brand/Product Marketing to maintain message consistency across stakeholders
    • VA Insights to define performance metrics and track outcomes
    • Patient Access & Reimbursement to support field-ready tools/ access messaging.
  • Contribute to launch readiness and lifecycle planning from a payer/customer lens.

Budget & Agency Management

  • Own the payer marketing budget; allocate spend to highest-impact initiatives.
  • Manage external partners (agencies, research firms, model vendors, design/content teams) with clear briefs, timelines, and performance expectations.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a strategic, business-facing analytics leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 5 years in payer marketing, market access marketing, or related market access/commercial roles in healthcare, biotech/pharma, or reimbursed digital health experience

OR

Master’s degree and 9 years in payer marketing, market access marketing, or related market access/commercial roles in healthcare, biotech/pharma, or reimbursed digital health experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 11 years in payer marketing, market access marketing, or related market access/commercial roles in healthcare, biotech/pharma, or reimbursed digital health experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Launch experience (pre-launch through post-launch) with payer-facing deliverables and access milestones.
  • Experience with AMCP dossiers, value frameworks, budget impact tools, and outcomes-based contracting narratives.
  • Strong analytical fluency (claims/coverage data, patient journey, contracting/access analytics).
  • Experience implementing omnichannel programs for payer audiences.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with strong commercial instincts
  • Executive-level communication and influence
  • Customer empathy and insight-driven decision-making
  • Collaboration across Market Access, Medical, Legal, HEOR, and Sales
  • Operational excellence and stakeholder management
  • High integrity and compliance-minded judgment

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

raw.description:
About the Role

This is a founding-team research and engineering position at a seed-stage, Y Combinator–backed startup building a wearable device that infers and interprets real-time emotional states. The company is early — prototypes are already on users' wrists — and this hire is expected to own and ultimately lead the core inference work as the team scales.

The role sits at the intersection of computational neuroscience and production machine learning. You will be the primary person responsible for the model that quantifies emotional states from wearable sensor data, and you are expected to carry that work from research through to deployment.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and iterate on the inference model that quantifies emotional states from multimodal wearable sensor signals (audio, biometric, and others).

  • Bridge neuroscience research — including frameworks such as active inference — and production-grade ML systems.

  • Collaborate closely with hardware and product team members to integrate the model into the wearable pipeline.

  • Take ownership of model performance, versioning, and deployment as the product moves toward broader release.

  • Help define the scientific and engineering roadmap for the inference layer as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • PhD in computational neuroscience, cognitive science, active inference, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience bridging neuroscience research and production machine learning systems — you can take a model from theory to deployment.

  • Strong Python proficiency for ML model development and deployment.

  • US work authorization required (visa transfers considered; new visa sponsorship is not available).

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with active inference or predictive coding frameworks.

  • Background working with wearable or physiological sensor data.

  • Comfort operating as both a researcher and an engineer in a fast-moving, small team.

Not a Fit

  • Wet-lab-only neuroscience backgrounds without computational or ML components.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base salary: ~$150,000 USD (or equivalent ~GBP 75,000 for London-based candidates)

  • Equity: Meaningful founding-team equity (up to 1–2%) commensurate with the seniority and founding nature of the role.

Location

Primary office locations are London, UK and San Francisco, CA, USA. The team is open to remote or hybrid arrangements in addition to on-site. Location is flexible for the right candidate.

Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

The Opportunity

  • Own critical financial systems end-to-end: from transaction authorization and ledger accounting, to credit decisioning, to rewards engines and payment processing.

  • Build net-new products, not just maintain existing ones: as Imprint expands into new financial products and a deeper rewards platform, you'll design and ship systems that don't exist yet alongside improving the ones that do.

  • Contribute to foundational platform work: invest in shared services, API infrastructure, and developer tooling that make the entire engineering team faster and more reliable.

  • Leverage AI across the stack: from prototyping to testing to production code, learning how to leverage AI tools is a core consideration for how we work.

  • Work across a wide cross-functional surface: product, design, infrastructure, compliance, solutions engineering, and brand partners.

  • Move fast with real responsibility: this is a growing company where individuals drive impact, not a large org where you wait for alignment.

At the senior level, you may also lead system design for your team's projects and help onboard and develop other engineers.

Your Profile

  • 3+ years of experience building production backend systems (fintech experience a plus)

  • You've built services that handle real money, real users, or real-time decisions: and you care about getting the details right

  • Proficiency in Go (our primary backend language), or a similar language with willingness to ramp quickly

  • Experience using AI tools (code assistants, MCP servers, agentic workflows) to accelerate development, or genuine enthusiasm to adopt them

  • Experience ensuring data consistency and transactional integrity across distributed systems

  • Strong with relational databases: schema design, migrations, and query performance tuning

  • Comfortable designing API contracts consumed by both internal frontends and external partners

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS), CI/CD pipelines, and deployment tooling

  • You've participated in on-call rotations and incident response, including root cause analysis

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate naturally across product, design, and engineering teams

  • You thrive in ambiguous environments and make pragmatic tradeoffs to keep shipping

We don't expect every candidate to match every bullet. If you're excited about what we're building and confident you can contribute, we'd love to talk.

Stack

Go, MySQL, DynamoDB, Temporal, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub Actions, Datadog, Statsig.

We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

This is our first marketing hire and a full-stack marketing role with full strategic ownership of Menlo's presence and pipeline in North America. You will set the direction and execute it, covering brand, content, demand generation, community, and go-to-market across our product portfolio: Asimov and the Menlo Platform. You will work closely with the founders and senior leadership across Singapore and Ho Chi Minh City, owning Menlo's US positioning and go-to-market strategy. This is an individual contributor role today with genuine strategic scope. You will define what marketing at Menlo looks like in the US, build it from the ground up, and shape the team that grows around it.

  • Build and grow Menlo's presence across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Discord, Reddit, and US-based developer communities

  • Build relationships with US-based press, analysts, research labs, enterprise buyers, and developer communities

  • Plan and execute presence at US industry events: conferences, meetups, and developer gatherings in the AI, robotics, and deep tech space

What You Will Bring

It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

The IT Quality Control Specialist oversees quality control and assurance of software, process, and data integrity validation processes. Provides guidance and support to operational teams within Sarah Cannon Research Institute to ensure compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and regulatory requirements. Works closely and effectively with Global Quality and Education, IT QC Specialists, Validation Specialists, Business Owners, Product Owners, and Product Analysts.

This is a remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.

What our IT Quality Control Specialist is responsible for:

  • Provides support to research operations and IT on the interpretation of corporate and regulatory requirements (standards/policies/procedures) related to software validation, quality management, and GxP and oversees quality activities related to software, process, and data integrity validation.

  • Provides review of validation life cycle documents including validation assessments, 21 CFR Part 11 assessments, system validation plans, risk management plans, and validation summary reports in adherence with SOPs, corporate policies, standards, and government regulations to ensure completeness and accuracy.

  • Provides support of quality guidance through the cycle of preparation, execution, data analysis, and report writing for IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols.

  • Assists with periodic review of system documentation according to defined schedule to ensure continued compliance with SOPs, corporate policies, standards, and government regulations.

  • Provides quality review of related to changes that impact validated systems and/or processes.

  • Other duties as assigned

  • Experience in GCP clinical space, such as CRO or SMO, is highly preferred

  • 3+ years' professional work experience in a clinical research, biotech, or pharmaceutical environment focused in FDA GxP requirements for systems, 21 CFR Part 11 and FDA software validation guidelines.

  • Experience and knowledge of EU regulations, e.g., Annex 11 is preferred.

  • Knowledge of industry and international standards for software quality, such as GAMP V, PIC/S, ICH, etc.

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

raw.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will own the design, analysis, and validation of the structural and kinematic systems that make Asimov move. You will take components from concept through production-ready hardware -- working across joints, actuators, enclosures, and structural members -- ensuring every design holds up mechanically and integrates cleanly with the broader electromechanical system.

What You'll Do

  • Design and develop mechanical assemblies across the full humanoid body, including joints, actuators, sensor mounts, and structural members

  • Develop detailed 3D part, drawings and assembly models across plastics, metal, and composite materials in Solidworks or equivalent CAD tools

  • Run hands-on test rigs: load testing, fatigue cycling, thermal soak, and kinematic validation across body segments

  • Execute DFM reviews alongside contract manufacturers, going to the floor to understand tooling constraints, cycle times, and failure modes firsthand

  • Create and maintain production drawings with GD&T and inspection callouts for handoff to CMs and QA

  • Set up and instrument test stands, wire sensors, and collect data to analyze failure modes and close the loop on design iterations

  • Work across plastics, metals, and composites, selecting materials and joining methods appropriate for the loading conditions and production intent

  • Coordinate with firmware and electrical teams to physically integrate actuators, sensors, and PCBs into mechanical assemblies, ensuring cable routing, connector access, and serviceability are accounted for

  • Contribute to Menlo's open-source hardware releases, including build guides, BOM documentation, and assembly instructions for the communityContribute to Menlo's open-source design efforts, including CAD releases, manufacturing documentation, and build guides for the broader robotics community

What You'll Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on mechanical design experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

  • Strong proficiency in Solidworks, across both detailed parts, multibody assemblies, surfaces and drawings

  • Proven track record with sheet metal fabrication and traditional/additive manufacturing

  • Experience with GD&T and producing 2D engineering drawings for manufacturing and QA

  • Ability to run FEA simulations; static, dynamic & thermal as well as interpret results to inform design decisions

  • Comfortable working within aggressive cost and weight constraints without sacrificing reliability

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with material selection, actuator selection, fasteners and mechanisms

  • Proficient in rapid prototyping methods (FDM, SLA, CNC, laser cutting) and able to support the team on design decisions spanning the full product lifecycle, from concept through end-of-life disassembly and material recovery

  • Strong communication skills to drive alignment across suppliers, cross-disciplinary engineers, and leadership

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware, legged locomotion platforms, or high DOF manipulators

  • Participated in robotics competitions

  • Familiarity with parallel mechanisms and non-standard joint configurations such as RSU ankle designs or parallel actuation

  • Knowledge of plastics engineering including material selection, shrinkage factors, and mechanical property optimization

  • Scripting or automation experience in Python to streamline CAD workflows and data analysis

  • Experience with deploying control systems to hardware

  • Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer

  • Prior involvement in robotics or wearable systems where mechanical tolerances and ergonomics are critical

Why Join Menlo?

You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. If you thrive in fast-paced, open-collaborative environments, let's build the future of robotics together.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Role Title: Thai Bilingual Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Thai Bilingual Experts to contribute to an impactful language and AI training project for a valued customer. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Listen to audio clips in Thai and evaluate the nativeness and fluency of the speaker or model output.
  2. Assess pronunciation, intonation, and linguistic authenticity according to established guidelines.
  3. Document your assessments with clear, concise written feedback in English, noting key linguistic factors.
  4. Provide detailed justifications for each evaluation to ensure clarity and consistency in results.

  6. Contribute insights to help improve AI model performance in Thai language understanding and generation.
  7. Ensure timely and accurate completion of assigned audio review tasks, maintaining high standards of quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Native-level proficiency in Thai, with strong command of both spoken and written language.
  2. Minimum B2 level proficiency in English, especially for written and verbal communication.
  3. Background in voice specialization, linguistics, phonetics, music/audio engineering, or related fields is prefered.
  4. Experience with audio analysis, transcription, or linguistic assessment is highly valued.
  5. Strong attention to detail and ability to articulate nuanced language differences.
  6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on clarity and accuracy.
  7. Familiarity with media, communications, or teaching is considered an asset.

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Sr. Director, MCD Commercial Delivery is responsible for the leading the delivery and operations of
SAP/Non-SAP workloads across multi-cloud environments for Commercial clients. This role will lead cross-
functional global delivery teams—including Linux, Windows, Cloud, DBA, and Service Desk functions—while
driving standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across service delivery. This Sr. Director
serves as the delivery interface for key enterprise clients, ensuring consistent service excellence, operational
governance, and customer satisfaction within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) framework.

Key Responsibilities

1)Service Delivery Operations

  • Oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring SLA compliance, incident closure, and proactive issue
    prevention.
    •Govern delivery operations across multiple Commercial accounts, managing both SAP and non-SAP
    workloads.
    •Lead tactical initiatives such as OS patching, DR drills, system upgrades, and cloud migrations.
    •Drive operational maturity through ITIL practices and continuous improvement programs.
    2)Governance & Client Management
    •Conduct regular service reviews (QBRs, MSRs) and executive reporting through dashboards and
    performance metrics. Maintain accurate documentation and reporting for delivery milestones and KPIs.
    •Manage client escalations with urgency and transparency, maintaining strong and trusted relationship.
    •Use ServiceNow and Jira to track tasks, incidents, problems, and changes across delivery streams.
    3)Cloud & Technical Oversight
    •Coordinate activities across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments — ensuring security, performance,
    and compliance.
    •Collaborate with Cloud Architects to optimize cost, automation, and resiliency.
    •Ensure SAP and non-SAP workloads follow hyperscaler best practices (e.g., HANA sizing, DR design,

clustering).

  • Demonstrate working knowledge of key cloud components such as EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, Azure
    VM/Storage/AD, and GCP Compute/Networking.

4)Leadership & Team Development

  • Mentor tower leads, engineers, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence to drive engagement
    and operational excellence.
    •Support workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, and performance management for delivery teams.
    5)Other duties as assigned.
    Basic Qualifications
    •10+ years of progressive experience in IT Managed Services, Cloud Delivery, or Infrastructure
    Operations, including large-scale enterprise environments.
    •3+ years in a leadership role (e.g., Delivery Lead, Engagement Manager, or Operations Director)
    managing cross-functional technical teams and client portfolios.
    •Demonstrated experience managing multi-cloud delivery operations (AWS, Azure, and GCP) and
    complex enterprise workloads.
    •Proven ability to use ServiceNow (Incident, Change, Problem, CMDB, Reporting) and Jira/Confluence
    (project tracking, sprint management).
    Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
    •Strong understanding of cloud and infrastructure delivery models, automation, and cost optimization
    strategies.
    •Experience managing SAP and non-SAP workloads in hybrid or cloud environments (S/4HANA, ECC,
    HANA DB).
    •Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, ITAR, DISA STIG, and industry security
    standards.
    •Proven ability to manage delivery P&L, drive financial performance, and improve resource utilization.
    •Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
    •Demonstrated ability to lead large, distributed teams with empathy, accountability, and collaboration.
    •Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
    •Deep understanding of ITIL principles and operational governance frameworks.
    •Strategic and operational agility with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
    •Demonstrates resiliency with the ability to quickly adapt to changes and challenges.
    •Certifications preferred: PMP, ITIL v4, AWS Certified Solutions Architect / Azure Administrator / GCP
    Professional Cloud Architect, Linux/Windows Certification, COMPTIA Sec+/Network+.
